title: Kastanienallee, Berlin
description:
✔️ Fully furnished serviced studio-apartment in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg – Kastanienallee
✔️ Modern living comfort in historic buildings dating back to 1898
✔️ Thoughtfully equipped with a kitchenette, private bathroom, and duplex single beds
✔️ Comfortable wooden stairway to the sleeping area, access via elevator for most rooms
✔️ Prime location: trendy Prenzlauer Berg with cafés, bars, boutiques, and cultural hotspots

🛋️ The Apartment
This serviced studio-apartment offers a perfect blend of historic charm and modern convenience. The sleeping area is located on the duplex level with comfortable single beds, accessible via a wooden stairway (please note the beds are not moveable, so may not be suitable for couples). The kitchenette includes a stove, microwave, kettle, fridge, and dishes. The private bathroom features a shower.

Your stay is serviced, meaning cleaning is provided once a week, and linen and towels are changed regularly (a cleaning fee of €70 per month applies). Most rooms are accessible via elevator, and barrier-free rooms can be arranged upon request. Laundry facilities with washing machine and dryer are available on campus at a surcharge.

Please note: This listing refers to a room category. Individual rooms may differ slightly from the images for this category.

🏢 Building & Services
The apartments are located in two historic buildings that were formerly classrooms of a school built in 1898. Security is a priority: building access requires a room key, and a night security guard is present at reception. The reception team is available from 7 am to 9 pm, and check-in is from 3 pm, check-out until 11 am. 

📍 Location
Located in the heart of Berlin’s trendy Prenzlauer Berg, Kastanienallee is nicknamed the “Casting Alley” due to frequent fashion and film shoots, and has been described as “Berlin’s coolest boulevard.” The area is full of cafés, bars, boutiques, and shops featuring Berlin designers. Once a historic working-class neighborhood and later home to intellectuals and artists during the communist era, Prenzlauer Berg is now a vibrant, sought-after district.

The park-like campus offers a green oasis in the city center, where guests can relax and enjoy the surroundings. The team on-site is happy to provide tips on navigating Berlin and making the most of your stay.

title: Buchholzer Straße, Berlin

Die schlichte Einrichtung setzt individuelle Akzente und bietet einige stylische Hingucker. Dabei haben wir darauf geachtet, dass Ihr alles findet, was Ihr für Euren stressfreien Berlinaufenthalt braucht. 

Hervorzuheben ist die totale zentrale Lage an den Hot Spots vom Prenzlauer Berg (Helmholtzplatz, Schönhauser Allee, Gethsemane Kirche, Kulturbrauerei, Mauerpark). Mehrere Cafés, Bars, Restaurants und trendige Geschäfte gibt es in unmittelbarer Nähe der Wohnung.

Verkehrsanbindung bestehen auch zum Rest Berlins über die Tram M1 und M12 (2Minuten von der Haustür) sowie über die Station Schönhauser Allee mit U2, S41, S42, S8, S9 (5 Minuten von der Haustür).

title: Warschauer Straße, Berlin
description:
Our Apartments are fully equipped and furnished apartments between 27-67m2. 
Each type of apartment has been individually designed and offers high quality. Our commitment is to provide a high standard of living comfort, emphasizing aesthetics and digitization, as well as respecting the privacy of our tenants.
With a balanced mix of natural materials and selected vintage pieces, we combine simplicity with a warm aesthetic. Here, it's easy to recharge your batteries and clear your head for the next day.

These spacious studio apartments with 37 square meters offers a spacious, warm atmosphere. The open living and dining area invites you to linger, whether you are alone or with your loved one.
Each apartment is accompanied by a craftsman bed, a complete designer kitchen, a 40-inch IP-TV, a dining table, a vintage armchair, reliably thick doors for privacy and extensive wardrobe space.
 
There is also a nicely tiled bathroom with beautiful basins and a bathtub/shower.

We keep fresh towels ready for you and a laundry service will be happy to take care of your laundry on request. Our launderette is equipped with top quality washing machines available 24 hours a day, every day. 

*Prices may vary depending on on floor level, on length of stay and rental period. After the lease agreement expires, new contracts for extending the stay are possible.

For tenants staying 1-3 months, we require just one month’s all-in rent as a deposit. For tenants staying 4-12 months, we will require two month’s all-in rent as a deposit. All of this is also shown in detail within our digital booking process.

Take a relaxed approach to deposit security. We have partnered with Garentii to offer a quick and comfortable solution. For a small fee, you can skip the deposit and save on upfront costs. Ready to say goodbye to deposits? 
IMPORTANT: To complete your booking, you must transfer the deposit or enrol with Garentii deposit insurance. Failing to do so, your application will not be processed.

You want to book directly your preferred apartment or take a look at our other apartment categories? 
Our booking process is fully digital and as comfortable as a hotel booking.

Life at Frankfurter Tor
Your new home at Frankfurter Tor is centered in Friedrichshain – a district known for its international atmosphere and vivacious energy. Bordering the districts of Kreuzberg, Neukölln and Mitte, it is home to many of Berlin’s most exciting creative industries and entrepreneurs.

What happens after your booking is completed on HousingAnywhere?

Good to know: After your booking has been confirmed on HousingAnywhere, you have to finalize your reservation in our system. The following steps have to be completed:
1. You will receive a link to our website by e-mail.
2. On our website, you have to select the apartment type you have booked on HousingAnywhere.
3. As the next step, you will receive password-protected access to our app where you can upload your ID card or passport and confirm the contract.
4. Afterward, we will check your details, and if everything fits you will receive an automatic e-mail with the payment request of the deposit (this payment differs from the HousingAnywhere booking fee!).
5. As soon as there are no more pending payments (within the next 5 business days) and we have received the money, we will finalize the booking and you will receive a final confirmation e-mail.
6. Please note that the booking through our system should be completed no later than 7 days after booking on HousingAnywhere. After 7 days, the room is no longer reserved for you and can be booked by others. Just before the semester starts, reservations can only be held for 2 days. In this case, a refund of the costs paid so far is not guaranteed.

Don’t worry, if you need any help, you are always welcome to contact us!

title: Dunckerstraße, Berlin
description:
Schöne lichtdurchflutete Wohnung im Prenzlauer Berg (Helmholtzplatz) mit einem Balkon und Blick auf den Park, voll möbliert, mit begehbarem Kleiderschrank, voll ausgestatteter Küche, großem Bad mit Badewanne und WC, Wohnzimmer und Schlafzimmer (zum ruhigen Hinterhof). Die sehr hochwertige Ausstattung bietet ein komfortables Zuhause auf Zeit zum Wohnen und Arbeiten. 

Die vollausgestattete Küche hat einen großen Esstisch, an dem gemütlich sechs Personen sitzen können. Kühlschrank mit Eisfächern, Spülmaschine, Geschirr, Ofen und Herd sind vorhanden.

Im Wohnzimmer befindet sich ein großes Sofa, ein Projektor, TV, ein großer Schreibtisch und Bürostuhl. 

Das renovierte Bad mit Badewanne und WC hat zwei kleine Schränke und eine Kammer, in der eine Waschmaschine steht.

Das Schlafzimmer ist mit einem 2m breiten Boxspringbett in Hotelqualität ausgestattet. Zum Schlafen kann das Zimmer mit Vorhängen abgedunkelt werden. Zudem befinden sich im Schlafzimmer zwei große wunderschöne Kleiderschränke.

Der gen Westen ausgerichtete Balkon kann sowohl vom Wohnzimmer als auch von der Küche betreten werden und lädt zu einem tollen Sonnenuntergang ein. Der Blick ist, wie auf den Fotos zu erkennen, nicht blockiert. Man hat eine wunderbare Sicht auf den Helmholtzplatz.

Eine stabile 100Mbit WLAN Internetverbindung ist vorhanden.

Das Haus verfügt über einen Aufzug.

Die Wohnung befindet sich in bester Lage mitten im angesagten Helmholtzviertel mit schönen Cafés, Restaurants und Bars - ideal für inspirierende Spaziergänge zur Erkundung der Stadt und Sehenswürdigkeiten. Der Wasserturm oder das Zeiss-Großplanetarium, der Märchenbrunnen oder viele tolle Restaurants sind alle zu Fuß zu erreichen.
Nicht weit entfernt findet man den Ernst-Thälmann- Park mit großem Schwimmbad oder der Friedrichshain zum Joggen oder für einen schönen Spaziergang. Der Alexanderplatz ist in 10 Minuten mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichbar.

Nächstliegende öffentliche Anbindungen, wie der S-Bahnhof Schönhauser Allee (S42 und S41 Ringbahn), die Tramstation Prenzlauer Allee/ Danziger Str (M10 und M4) sind fußläufig zu erreichen.

title: Prenzlauer Promenade, Berlin
description:
Schöne moderne neue Wohnung in Berlin.
Vollausgestattete Wohnung in eine zentrale Lage in Berlin .

title: Cantianstraße, Berlin
description:
The generously cut, light-flooded attic apartment offers a cozy living atmosphere with two balconies and beautiful views over the city.
The entire apartment is equipped with well-kept oak parquet flooring. The bright, open kitchen with induction hob, dishwasher and access to one of the balconies forms the center. The living room has a designer couch, stylish workstation, AppleTV and another balcony. In the bedroom you will find a large cozy double bed and a spacious built-in wardrobe. All rooms have a Sonos sound system, which can be controlled via app.
The apartment is equipped with a washer-dryer. Bed linen, towels, hair dryer are also available. A 14-day cleaning service is already included in the rental price.

The apartment is located on the 5th floor in a diverse residential area on the popular Prenzlauer Berg. In the surrounding area you will find a variety of cafes, restaurants and stores. Mauerpark is within walking distance and invites you to relax and stroll through the flea market on weekends.
The apartment is ideally connected to the public transport network. S-Bahn, U-Bahn and streetcar are only a few minutes walk away.

There are lots of cafes, restaurants and bakerys only a few steps away. 
The famous Mauerpark ist only 200m away - the place of the sundday fleamarket - place for artists to perform music.

title: Berliner Straße, Berlin
description:
Diese hochwertig möblierte 4-Zimmer-Wohnung mit ca. 80 m2 befindet sich in begehrter Lage in Pankow / Prenzlauer Berg und überzeugt durch einen durchdachten Grundriss sowie stilvolles Retro-Design.

Die Wohnung bietet zwei separate Schlafzimmer, ein großzügiges Wohnzimmer, eine separate Küche sowie ein separates Badezimmer und ein Abstellraum, der gerne als Büro eingerichtet werden kann. Ergänzt wird das Raumangebot durch ein zusätzliches Zimmer, das mit einem Hochbett, einem Fernseher und einem kleinen Sofa ausgestattet ist. Dieses Zimmer eignet sich ideal als Kinderzimmer, Gästezimmer, Arbeitszimmer oder privater Rückzugsraum.

Die Wohnung ist vollständig und hochwertig möbliert mit ausgewählten Retromöbeln und ermöglicht ein sofortiges, komfortables Einziehen. Der Balkon sorgt für zusätzlichen Wohnkomfort und lädt zum Verweilen ein.

Ideal für eine kleine Familie oder ein Paar, das eine stilvolle, ruhige und zugleich gut angebundene Wohnung sucht.

title: Ebertystraße, Berlin
description:
Willkommen in unserer wunderschön möblierten 2-Zimmer-Wohnung im lebendigen Stadtteil Friedrichshain in Berlin. Diese moderne und gut gestaltete Wohnung bietet einen komfortablen Wohnraum und ist perfekt für Einzelpersonen oder Paare, die nach einer stilvollen und praktischen Unterkunft suchen.

Die Wohnung verfügt über ein ruhiges Schlafzimmer zum Innenhof hin mit einem großen Doppelbett und eine gemütliche Küche mit Essbereich. Die Küche ist voll ausgestattet mit einem Elektroherd, Backofen, Kühlschrank, eingebautem Gefrierfach, Kapsel-Kaffeemaschine, Toaster, Wasserkocher und einer Waschmaschine. Alle notwendigen Utensilien für den täglichen Gebrauch sind ebenfalls vorhanden.

Das Badezimmer ist mit einer Dusche/Badewanne ausgestattet und frische Handtücher werden bereitgestellt. Zusätzlich werden Bettwäsche für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt zur Verfügung gestellt. Wenn Sie zusätzliche Geräte oder Gegenstände benötigen, stellen wir Ihnen diese gerne kurzfristig zur Verfügung.

Das Schlafzimmer verfügt außerdem über einen großen Schrank.

Eine High-Speed-Internetverbindung (1000 MBits) ist in der gesamten Wohnung verfügbar und es gibt einen Arbeitsbereich, ideal für diejenigen, die ein Homeoffice benötigen.

Die Wohnung befindet sich in einem typischen Berliner "Altbau" Gebäude im ersten Stock und bietet einen Balkon, auf dem Sie entspannen und die Umgebung genießen können.

Unsere Wohnung liegt im ruhigeren "Hagenauer Kiez" und somit im Herzen von Berlin. Sie haben eine bequeme Anbindung an verschiedene beliebte Stadtviertel. Nur 5 Minuten zu Fuß entfernt befinden sich der Boxhagener Kietz, das Bötzow Viertel und Prenzlauer Berg, und etwa 10 Minuten entfernt liegen der Alexanderplatz und das lebhafte Mitte-Viertel.

Die Nachbarschaft bietet eine Vielzahl von Annehmlichkeiten, darunter Lebensmittelgeschäfte, Cafés und Restaurants. Alles, was Sie brauchen, liegt nur wenige Minuten von Ihrer Haustür entfernt.

Für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr erreichen Sie bequem die Straßenbahn oder Sie gehen nur 5 Minuten zur Ringbahn, die Ihnen eine bequeme Anbindung nach West-Berlin bietet.

Verpassen Sie nicht die Gelegenheit, in dieser attraktiven und gut angebundenen Wohnung in einer der begehrtesten Wohngegenden Berlins zu übernachten. Buchen Sie jetzt, um Ihren Aufenthalt in Friedrichshain zu sichern!

Hinweis: Mindestaufenthalt erforderlich. Bitte kontaktieren Sie uns für Verfügbarkeit und Preise.

title: Heinersdorfer Straße, Berlin
description:
Modern und gemütlich eingerichtetes Studio mit allem, was man für einen sorglosen Aufenthalt braucht.
Nur ein paar Schritte vom Caligariplatz entfernt befindet sich dieses zentral und doch ruhig gelegene Apartment. Zentral und mit Blick auf den Fernsehturm (Alex) und doch ruhig, da in einer Sackgasse, also ohne Durchgangsverkehr, gelegen. Im fußläufigen Umkreis befinden sich Cafés, Supermärkte, Spätis, Restaurants sowie Haltestellen der Trams, die dich in alle Richtungen befördern.
Top eingerichtete, ruhige Wohnung mit einem kombinierten Wohn- und Schlafzimmer, einer kleinen aber hochwertigen, voll ausgestatteten Küche und einem Balkon sowie dem Vorteil einer Klimaanlage.
Diese geschmackvoll und hochwertig eingerichtete Wohnung verfügt über ein abschließbares Wohn-/Schlafzimmer mit offenem Küchenbereich. Das kombinierte Wohn-/Schlafzimmer ist mit echtem Parkett und einem Schlafsofa/Bett für 2 Personen (140cmx200cm) ausgestattet. Ein großer Kleiderschrank sowie ein Regal für Wäsche/ Utensilien sind im Flur vorhanden. Ein 55 Zoll Smart-TV trägt zur Unterhaltung bei. 
Eine große Fensterfront mit Ausgang zum Balkon bringt Licht ins Zimmer. Möchtest du es lieber diskret und dunkel, kannst du mit Jalousien und Vorhängen den Raum verdunkeln.
Wird es im Sommer mal zu heiß, trägt die Klimaanlage zur Abkühlung bei.
In der hochwertigen kleinen Einbauküche  findest du sämtliche Utensilien, die du zum Kochen benötigst. Wasserkocher, Kaffeemaschine (auf Wunsch Kaffee-Automat) 
Toaster, Eierkocher, Mixer und Mikrowelle sind vorhanden.
Selbstverständlich nimmt dir ein kleiner Geschirrspüler den Abwasch ab. 
Im Badezimmer kannst du mit der Dusche für Frische und Sauberkeit sorgen. 
Die Wohnung befindet sich im 3.OG eines Mehrfamilienhauses.  Ein Fahrstuhl ist vorhanden.
Bei Bedarf kann ein großer Tiefgaragen-Stellplatz dazu gemietet werden.
Im Keller des Hauses gibt es Waschmaschine und Trockner, die Mieter gemeinschaftlich gegen eine kleine Gebühr nutzen können.

Public parking spaces can usually be found in front of the house.

description:
Die geräumige, helle und sonnige 3-Zimmer Altbau Wohnung mit Erker und Balkon befindet sich im 4. Stock in bester Kiezlage zwischen Boxhagener Platz und Ostkreuz. Die Stimmung in der Wohngegend ist jung, positiv, kreativ.

Der Grundriss der Wohnung ist klassisch, alle drei Zimmer haben eine Deckenhöhe von ca.3,40m und teilweise Stuck. Jedes Zimmer hat Fenster. Alle Zimmer gehen vom geräumigen Flur ab, es gibt kein Durchgangszimmer. Details: Echtholz-Fischgrätenparkett, eine moderne Küche mit hochwertigen Materialien wie,Jade-Schiefer Arbeitsplatte und hochwertige Küchengeräte. Im Badezimmer mit Wanne und separater Dusche sorgen zwei große Fenster für viel Tageslicht. Im Kontrast zu den neuen Wänden zeugen eine Backsteinwand und zwei erhaltene "Vintage Wände" von der historischen Vergangenheit der Wohnung. Schöne, wohnliche Vorhänge, sowie ein großes, breites Boxspringbett und geschmackvolle Kunst tragen zum Wohnkomfort bei. Die Heizkörper sind hocheffizient. Neben der gemütlichen Couch und dem großen Flatscreen TV, ist eine Leseecke mit einem kleinen Büchervorrat im Erker vorhanden. Fast alle Lichter sind dimmbar, teilweise per Fernbedienung. Ein Sekretär bietet Platz für Homeoffice Tätigkeiten. Geschirr, Kochutensilien, Bettwäsche und Handtücher sind für bis zu zwei Personen vorrätig.

Die Wohnung befindet sich in der Wühlischstraße in dem beliebten Stadtviertel Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg. Cafés, Bioläden, Supermärkte und Restaurants sind in unmittelbarer Nähe zu finden. Erholung findet man z.B. an der nahegelegenen Rummelsburger Bucht, an dem Boxhagener Platz und im Treptower Park. Die Verkehrsanbindung ist mit S-Bahn, Strassenbahn und DB Fernverkehr hervorragend. Ein Kellerraum ist vorhanden, Fahrräder können auf dem Innenhof abgestellt werden. In der Miete sind die Rundfunkgebühren (GEZ) bereits enthalten.

Der Friedrichshainer Kiez zeichnet sich durch ein junges, dynamische und kreatives Flair aus.

Die Lage ist sehr gut: Direkt um die Ecke befindet sich der große Volkspark Friedrichshain, ideal zum Spazieren und Erholen. Zahlreiche Supermärkte, Cafés, Bars, Restaurants und viele Sportstudios sind fußläufig erreichbar. Die Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr ist hervorragend: Straßenbahn zur Warschauer Straße, Alexanderplatz und Hauptbahnhof sowie die Ringbahn-Station Greifswalder Straße sind in wenigen Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar.
Das Haus ist ruhig, nicht hellhörig, und die Nachbarn sind sehr nett.

The apartment is quietly located on the top floor and offers about 50 square meters with two rooms: a bedroom, a small hallway, a pantry, and a living room with an open kitchen. The absolute highlight is the large terrace with views over Berlin’s rooftops and a direct sightline to the TV tower. The terrace faces northwest and invites you to enjoy beautiful sunsets every evening.
The rooms are very bright, especially the living room with floor-to-ceiling windows. The spacious bathroom features a bathtub. The open kitchen is equipped with a dishwasher, and a washing machine is also available.
The apartment is fully furnished, including a height-adjustable desk, a large dining table, an air fryer, and a coffee machine. The internet connection is very fast and reliable – ideal for working from home. Quiet ceiling fans provide comfortable air circulation during the summer.
The location is excellent: just around the corner is the large Volkspark Friedrichshain, perfect for walks and relaxation. Numerous supermarkets, cafés, bars, restaurants, and many fitness studios are within walking distance. Public transport connections are outstanding: trams to Warschauer Straße, Alexanderplatz, and Hauptbahnhof as well as the Greifswalder Straße Ringbahn station are all reachable within a few minutes on foot.
The building is quiet and well insulated against noise, and the neighbors are very friendly.

title: Heinersdorfer Straße, Berlin
description:
Top eingerichtete, ruhige Wohnung mit 2 Zimmern, einer hochwertigen, voll ausgestatteten Küche und einem Balkon zur Südseite sowie dem Vorteil einer Klimaanlage.
Diese geschmackvoll und hochwertig eingerichtete Wohnung verfügt über ein abschließbares Schlafzimmer sowie über ein Wohnzimmer mit offenem Küchenbereich. Das Schlafzimmer ist mit neuem Teppichboden und einem Bett für 2 Personen (180cmx200cm) ausgestattet. Ein kleiner Kleiderschrank sowie ein Regal für Wäsche/ Utensilien sind im Schlafzimmer vorhanden. Ein 50 Zoll Smart-TV trägt zur Unterhaltung bei. 
Im Wohnzimmer mit offener Küche  sorgt ein großes Sofa in U-Form für Gemütlichkeit und Entspannung. Mit dem neuen 55-Zoll Smart-TV kannst du deine Lieblingsdienste streamen. Auf Wunsch gerne mit dem Service „Magenta-TV“.
Eine große Fensterfront zur Südseite bringt Licht ins Zimmer. Möchtest du es lieber diskret und dunkel, kannst du mit Jalousien und schweren, hochwertigen Vorhängen den Raum verdunkeln.
Wird es im Sommer mal zu heiß, trägt die Klimaanlage zur Abkühlung bei.
In der hochwertigen Einbauküche in L-Form findest du sämtliche Utensilien, die du zum Kochen benötigst. Wasserkocher, Kaffeemaschine (auf Wunsch Kaffee-Automat) 
Toaster, Eierkocher, Mixer und Mikrowelle sind vorhanden.
Selbstverständlich nimmt dir ein Geschirrspüler den Abwasch ab. 
Im Badezimmer kannst du ein entspanntes Bad genießen oder mit der Dusche für Frische und Sauberkeit sorgen. Eine kleine Waschmaschine findet ebenfalls im Bad seinen Platz. 
Die Wohnung befindet sich sehr ruhig gelegen im 3.OG eines Gartenhauses (Hinterhaus). 
Bei Bedarf kann ein großer Tiefgaragen-Stellplatz dazu gemietet werden.
Im Keller des Vorderhauses gibt es Waschmaschine und Trockner, die Mieter gemeinschaftlich nutzen können.

title: Greifswalder Straße, Berlin
description:
Cozy & quiet backyard apartment in Prenzlauer Berg.
This newly refurbished 35sqm apartment offers everything you need for your stay in Berlin. Overlooking a green and quiet backyard, it is located on the 2nd floor of a classic, early 20th century Berlin townhouse in lovely Prenzlauer Berg. The area is handily connected to anywhere in the city via the M4 tram line right outside the door, the Ringbahn city circle line only 500m away, and multiple bus stops within short walking distance. The tastefully decorated and spacious bed- and living room gets flooded by the late afternoon sun and comes with a cozy couch corner, a large flatscreen TV and plenty of storage space. The adjacent bathroom features a spacious shower bath, toilet and sink with cupboard and illuminated mirror, as well as a small window to the backyard. The cleverly designed and fully equipped kitchen doubles as a work and eating  area with a custom built counter/desk right in front of a large window with green backyard views. The apartment comes equipped with:

- Dishwasher
- Washing machine
- Microwave
- Toaster, kettle
- Nespresso machine 
- Fridge/freezer
- Large LCD TV
- Central heating
- Bathtub

Last but not least the all-connecting hallway has enough space for a large shoe cupboard and wardrobe setup. The apartment comes with unlimited access to a 250 MBit Wifi connection, all required sheets, linen and towels and all amenity bills included.

title: Choriner Straße, Berlin
description:
Description in English  / German 

Prime location in Berlin Mitte: bright furnished 3-room apartment with balcony & shared garden. Near Rosenthaler Platz. Limited to 2 years.

This furnished and bright 3-room apartment is located in one of Berlin’s most sought-after residential areas – right in the heart of Berlin-Mitte, bordering Prenzlauer Berg. Rosenthaler Platz can be reached within 4 minutes on foot, while Zionskirchplatz is only a 2-minute walk away.

The apartment benefits from excellent public transport connections. Several bus and tram (M1, M8, M12) lines as well as the U2 and U8 underground lines are within easy walking distance, providing fast access to all parts of the city. Train stations Alexanderplatz and Berlin Hauptbahnhof can also be reached in less than 30 minutes.

The neighborhood offers everything that defines vibrant Berlin city life: a wide selection of parks, cafés, restaurants, bars, bakeries, organic food stores, supermarkets, boutiques, bookstores, gyms, medical services and more. Popular destinations such as Mauerpark and Kulturbrauerei are also close by and offer plenty of cultural and leisure activities.

Public street parking is available (resident permit or parking fee required). Various car-sharing services are located nearby.

Despite its central location, the apartment is situated on a quiet side street with little traffic. The green shared courtyard and the south-west facing balcony provide peaceful outdoor spaces ideal for relaxing.

The apartment building does not have an elevator.

--------------------------------
Top-Lage: Möblierte helle 3-Zimmer-Wohnung in Berlin-Mitte nahe Prenzlauer Berg mit Balkon & Gemeinschaftsgarten. Befristet für max. 2 Jahre

Diese stilvoll möblierte und lichtdurchflutete 3-Zimmer-Wohnung befindet sich in einer der begehrtesten Wohnlagen Berlins – im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte, direkt an der Schnittstelle zu Prenzlauer Berg. Der Rosenthaler Platz ist in ca. 4 Gehminuten erreichbar, der Zionskirchplatz sogar in nur 2 Minuten.

Die Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr ist hervorragend: Mehrere Bus- und Straßenbahnlinien sowie die U-Bahn-Linien U2 und U8 befinden sich in fußläufiger Nähe und ermöglichen eine schnelle Verbindung in alle Teile der Stadt.

Die Umgebung bietet alles, was urbanes Leben in Berlin ausmacht: Parks, zahlreiche Cafés, Restaurants, Bars, Bäckereien, Bio-Märkte, Supermärkte, Boutiquen, Buchhandlungen, Fitnessstudios sowie Ärzte und weitere Dienstleistungen befinden sich direkt im Umfeld. Beliebte Orte wie der Mauerpark und die Kulturbrauerei sind ebenfalls schnell erreichbar und laden zu Freizeit, Kultur und Erholung ein.

Für Autofahrer stehen Parkmöglichkeiten im öffentlichen Straßenraum (Anwohnerparken bzw. Parkschein) zur Verfügung. Mehrere Car-Sharing-Anbieter sind ebenfalls in unmittelbarer Nähe vertreten.

Trotz der zentralen Lage liegt die Wohnung in einer ruhigen, wenig befahrenen Nebenstraße. Besonders der grüne Innenhof zur gemeinschaftlichen Nutzung sowie der Balkon mit Süd-West-Ausrichtung bieten ideale Rückzugsorte zum Entspannen.

Das Mehrfamilienhaus verfügt über keinen Aufzug.

title: Petersburger Straße, Berlin
description:
This light-filled corner apartment combines classic Altbau character with the comfort of a fully modern home. Located in a historic building that was completely renovated in 2016, the apartment features soaring 3.2-meter (10.5-foot) ceilings, large windows, and open views across PetersburgerPlatz toward the historic Pfingstkirche. The result is an airy, sunlit retreat in the heart of the city.

The 118-square-meter (1,270-square-foot) four-room layout offers exceptional flexibility. In addition to two comfortable bedrooms, there is a generous Study that can function equally well as a private home office, a formal dining room for ten or more guests, or a guest bedroom. A sleek gourmet kitchen, two full bathrooms, abundant built-in storage, and an in-unit washer and dryer make the apartment ideal for extended stays. The apartment is fully furnished and equipped with fresh linens, complete kitchenware, spacious wardrobes (Schränke) in each bedroom, a 4K flat-screen television, and high-speed Wi-Fi.

The building has an elevator and secure bicyle storage in the Innenhof. The building entrance is just steps from the quiet, efficient M10 Tram, providing effortless access to Mitte and many of the former East Berlin’s most interesting neighborhoods. A mix of delightful cafés, bakeries, shops, and restaurants are right outside your door, with chic Prenzlauer Berg, historic Samariter Viertel, and vibrant Boxhagener Platz all close by.

This apartment is a carefully maintained second home of two former architects and is offered only to guests requiring temporary housing in Berlin for a defined period, with the understanding that the owners require the apartment for their own family use after the lease ends.

The 1-room apartment on offer is an attic apartment in Friedrichshain, that has been expanded and fully equipped in 2020. The living and bedroom has access to a terrace. title: Meyerbeerstraße, Berlin
description:
Weißensee is Berlin’s secret weapon: leafy, calm, effortlessly cool, and close enough to the action without having it interrupt your sleep schedule. This fully furnished WG apartment gives you room to land properly before you’ve worked out which Kiez is actually yours.

Step outside and you get the best of Weißensee: the lake, green streets, neighbourhood cafés, classic Berlin architecture, and a slower, more luxurious rhythm than the city centre. And when you're ready for more, it's 20 minutes from the door to Alexanderplatz with the M4, less if you're a bicyclist. 10 minutes to Greifswalder station / the Ringbahn / PBerg. 

The apartment

Shared flat: you and one single roommate.
Berlin Dielen: Original wooden floorboards
Home office: Separate shared home office/study
Entertainment: Smart TVs in both bedrooms
Storage: Generous wardrobes and under-bed storage, along with a basement compartment.

Fully Equipped
The apartment is ready for everyday living, including:
- Fully equipped kitchen with high-quality cookware
- Washing machine
- Fridge / Freezer
- Additional second freezer
- Whole-apartment water filtration
- Three-stage reverse-osmosis drinking-water system
- Bidet attachment
- High-speed internet (1000mb down / 50mb up)

Rental Details

Rent includes water, internet, furnishings, and normal residential consumption of heating and electricity; material excess energy consumption is charged separately at actual cost.

Anmeldung available; Wohnungsgeberbestätigung can be provided.
Proof of employment required.
This is a private apartment, not a serviced residence; regular cleaning is undertaken by the tenants.

title: Wadzeckstraße, Berlin
description:
Fully Furnished & Equipped Studio – 300 m from Alexanderplatz | Berlin-Mitte

This fully furnished and equipped 29.13 m2 studio apartment is located in the modern Studio residential complex at Wadzeckstraße 4, 10178 Berlin-Mitte, approximately 300 meters (4 minutes' walk) from Alexanderplatz.

Completed in 2016, the building has a supermarket on the ground floor, communal laundry and drying facilities, and elevator access. Shops, restaurants, cafés, and public transportation are all within a few minutes' walk.

Water, heating, and internet are included in the rent. Address registration (Anmeldung) is possible.

The Apartment – Fully Furnished and Equipped

The studio is furnished and ready to move into, with furniture and household essentials provided.

Living and Sleeping Area

Bed with mattress, pillows, duvet, and bed linen

Wardrobe and storage space for clothes and personal belongings

Desk and chair for studying or working from home

Comfortable living and sleeping area

Wi-Fi internet connection

Large floor-to-ceiling windows providing natural light

Parquet flooring and underfloor heating

Kitchen and Dining

Fitted kitchenette with cooking hob and microwave

Refrigerator

Sink and kitchen storage cabinets

Pots, pans, and cooking utensils

Plates, bowls, glasses, mugs, and cutlery

Private Bathroom

Shower

Washbasin and toilet

Towel radiator

Building Facilities

Supermarket/convenience store directly on the ground floor for groceries and everyday essentials

Communal washing machines and drying facilities in the basement

Bicycle parking facilities

Passenger elevator

Location and Public Transportation

The apartment is just a short walk from Alexanderplatz, one of Berlin's main transportation hubs, providing convenient connections throughout the city.

200 m | 3 minutes: Nearest tram stop

300 m | 4 minutes: Alexanderplatz U-Bahn and S-Bahn station

300 m | 4 minutes: Regional trains, trams, and buses at Alexanderplatz

Alexanderplatz serves U-Bahn lines U2, U5, U8 and S-Bahn lines S3, S5, S7, S9.

Restaurants, Shopping, and Nearby Attractions

The surrounding neighborhood has a wide selection of supermarkets, shops, cafés, and restaurants. There are approximately 15–25 restaurants within a 5-minute walk and 40–70 within a 10-minute walk, including German, Italian, Asian, Indian, and other international cuisines.

Other nearby destinations include:

300 m | 4 minutes: Alexanderplatz – shops, restaurants, and public transportation

350 m | 5 minutes: Shopping center

800 m | 10–11 minutes: Volkspark Friedrichshain – walking, jogging, and recreation

1.9 km | 24–26 minutes: Humboldt University

Suitable for Students and Professionals

The apartment is particularly convenient for international students, university researchers, interns, and professionals staying in Berlin for several months.

Its central location makes commuting easy, while the furnished interior, equipped kitchenette, included internet, supermarket in the building, and on-site laundry facilities make everyday living convenient.

A fully furnished and equipped private studio in central Berlin, just 300 meters from Alexanderplatz, with water, heating, internet, and address registration included.

title: Mainzer Straße, Berlin
description:
This sun-drenched, stylishly furnished flat is located on the 4th floor of a typical Berlin old building in the middle of the trendy Friedrichshain district. The flat is fully furnished, has fast internet and is absolutely quiet due to its location in the first backyard.

The living room / bedroom has a comfortable 1.40m wide bed, a cosy sofa and a beautiful antique desk. A modern blackout system and beamer incl. projection screen are also installed. Bedside table, bed drawers and a spacious wardrobe provide sufficient storage space.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped with electric cooker, oven, microwave, a large fridge and freezer, washing machine, crockery and cooking utensils, coffee machine, kettle, toaster and a cosy, bright dining area. The bathroom has a shower, toilet, towels and plenty of storage space. The hallway offers plenty of space for wardrobe, shoes and utensils; practical utensils such as cleaning and washing powder, hoover, iron, hairdryer, extension cord and first aid kit are also provided.


LOCATION

The flat is located in a quiet street characterised by old buildings in the middle of the Boxhagener Kiez, one of the most sought-after neighbourhoods in Berlin. Numerous restaurants with dishes from all over the world, trendy pubs, beer gardens, cinemas and the traditional weekly market on Boxhagener Platz are only a few minutes' walk away. Legendary Berlin cult places such as Simon-Dach-Strasse and the world-famous techno club Berghain are also within walking distance.

There are many supermarkets nearby, some of which are open until 11 pm, as well as countless Spätis and numerous other shopping opportunities. Short-term parking spaces are available for a fee and there is an e-charging station directly in front of the building. 200 metres away there is a multi-storey car park with a long-term parking option.

The underground station Samariterstraße (U5) is also directly in front of the building. The journey time to Alexanderplatz is eight minutes, to the city centre (Mitte) ten minutes and to the main railway station 16 minutes. In addition, several tram lines as well as the S-Bahn station Frankfurter Allee (Ringbahn), which is about a 15-minute walk away, provide convenient transport connections in all directions.

This is a non-smoking flat.

The entire apartment was fully refurbished and furnished in November 2013.

Located in the heart of the up and coming district of Friedrichshain. Lots of restaurants, bars, cafes and shops right around the corner in Boxhagener Platz. The closest supermarket is across Frankfurter Allee, directly on the other side at numbers 35/37. Under an arcade called Rathaus passage there's a small Edeka. The Japanese restaurant called Onsen, at the corner of Simon-Dach-Strasse and Boxhagener Strasse and nearby Lemongrass Thai restaurant are worth a visit. Around the corner, in Gartenstrasse 22 there's a wonderful place named Honigmond to have breakfast, lunch etc. Simon-Dach-Strasse is a real mecca of restaurants and bars. Next stations: subway Samariterstrasse in 500m and Frankfurter Tor in 600m. Tram station in 150m.

title: Löwestraße, Berlin
description:
This charming and spacious loft has a huge living room with a modern open plan kitchen and a piano. A terrace is connected to the living room. There are two bedrooms (one with a king size, the other with a queen size bed). The spacious bathroom has a tub and a shower.

Located in the vibrant district of Friedrichshain, famous for the many shops, cafes, restaurants and bars. The apartment itself is situated in a quiet residential street, there is easy parking in the area, in case you decide to come by car. Next subway stations are Weberwiese in app. 220m and Frankfurter Tor. You can also take a walk to the flea market at Boxhagener Platz or to Karl Marx Allee, known for its monumental architecture.

title: Bänschstraße, Berlin
description:
Great apartment, stylish furnished and decorated to a very high standard and love to detail to become a genuine home. There are a Smart TV  and I-Pod/Phone speakers for home entertainment. The multifunctional couch designed by Studio Copenhagen can be easily transformed into several individual shapes. The couch is very versatile, it can be used as a sofa and as a bed, but pull the two seats apart and for two individual seats with a central coffee table which can also be configured as two individual beds. The bedroom has a queen size bed, a desk as well as a large cabinet accomplished along stucco ceilings facing the quiet courtyard for a peaceful sleep. The fully equipped and new built in kitchen has modern appliances including an induction stove, a dish washer, a washer/dryer combination, a "SMEG" fridge as well as a wonderful bistro table and chairs to start your day with a great breakfast and coffee. The small but charming bathroom has a shower. Step out the balcony and enjoy lovely views to one of the most authentic and quiet streets in Friedrichshain. 

The apartment is located at one of the most wanted authentic areas in Friedrichshain (Samariterkiez) - surrounded by diverse restaurants, bars, small boutiques and galleries. It's called the new creative center of town - with easy access to Kreuzberg, Neukoelln and Mitte. The buildings on nearby Karl-Marx Allee and Frankfurter Allee are important landmarks from GDR times. In 100m distance, there is Samariterstr. subway station. Nearby the apartment there is also a stop of the M10 tram line, which runs all around the clock. Also Boxhagener Platz with its famous flea market on saturdays and sundays (10-18h) is nearby. The famous East Side Gallery is within15-20 minutes walking from the apartment and so is River Spree for a breeze and amazing views as well boat rides can be easily booked.

title: Anklamer Straße, Berlin
description:
Brand new renovated and furnished, spacious Apartment on the 1st floor of a historical building. The living is tastefully decorated, so is the bedroom with king size bed, large cupboards and a modern contemporary kitchen with all new appliances. The daylight bathroom is the absolut highlight including a bath tub and a big square washing-basin and a cabinet with washing machine. At the moment there are some constructions around the buildings tto be finalized so the price is lower.

The apartment is located at one of the most desired spots in Mitte border to Prenzlauerberg within a quiet courtyard. Just around the corner from the beautiful Arkonaplatz with its pretty gardens and playgrounds for children. Also famous for its weekends fleamarket. Lots of diverse restaurants and bars right in front of your doorstep. Also Mauerpark and Weinbergspark are within walking distance. Pretty much everything can be reached very easily.

title: Strausberger Platz, Berlin
description:
The apartment lies on 10th floor in one of two The Henselmannn towers and can be comfortably reached with a lift. As you enter the grand foyer you`ll notice a classy yet arty vibe with attention to detail which welcomes you. Apart from the impressive artworks and the interior so is the view from the apartment down on Straussberger Platz. This clean and modern apartment is made authentic through its eclectic and tasteful décor, featuring unique furniture and pieces collected from around the world. The apartment's pristine dark wooden parquets, featured throughout. The spacious bedroom enjoys a comfortable king size bed for a peaceful sleep including spectacular views. The custom made kitchen is a real eye catcher and is fully equipped including modern appliances. The day light bathroom is another highlight despite from the black and white marble finishings is the stylish bath tub. An extra storage room is also near the entrance.

Perfectly central located. The apartment is located in Friedrichsh(hidden)order to Mitte, directly on Straussberger Platz. From the station a few steps away, the subway U5 takes you to the heart of town and Alexanderplatz in Berlin-Mitte within five minutes. From here all of the highlights of the city are easily reached - from the Central Station to the Museum Island, Reichstag, Brandenburg Gate and other important historical monuments can be reached within walking distance or public transport.

title: Inselstraße, Berlin
description:
This charming, newly renovated apartment is sited towards the lush courtyard of a lovely renovated traditional building. It is located on the ground floor and has a comfortable terrace. The studio apartment is lovely decorated, has a queen size bed, flatscreen TV, a built in cabinet and has an open plan kitchen with a bar plus an additional breakfast table. The large marble bathroom has a tub, washing machine and dryer. Naturally WIFI internet is provided too. There is an elegant entrance to the building and a basement for luggage storage.

The apartment is located in the south of Mitte, near Maerkisches Ufer and the historical port Also you can find a variety of different little restaurants taking place on boats where you can enjoy the breeze and views. It is surrounded by lush parks and embassy gardens and represents an ideal place for walks or jogging and a swimming pool is also close by. The peaceful Koellnischer Park around the corner hosts the living symbol of Berlin: two brown bears. From the apartment in 5-10 minutes walk you reach the historic Nikolaiviertel and the central Alexanderplatz (2 stops by subway). The stations Maerkisches Museum, Heinrich-Heinestrasse and Jannowitzbruecke giving access to five major subway and train lines can be reached in short walks. Boat trips through Berlin can be taken from the nearby riverbank. Despite its very central location the neighbourhood remains a peaceful one.

title: Inselstraße, Berlin
description:
This lovely newly renovated apartment on the third floor of a centrally located Berliner building has a lot of light and colourful charm. It offers one room, a very well furnished kitchen, a large high-quality bathroom with a tub and a balcony where one can sit comfortably. The decorations of this charming flat are unique and include two oil paintings from Burmese and Cambodian contemporary artists, a nice Buddha statue and an exquisite Kuba textile panel from Africa. All furniture and equipment are brand new including a queen size bed, large mirror closet, desk, table and chairs and a leather sofa chair. A flat screen TV and DVD player, fast wireless internet, washing machine with incorporated dryer, microwave, vacuum cleaner, toaster, hair dryer, towels and linen are available. The flat is on the quite internal side of the building which has an elegant entrance and green court yard. There is luggage storage in the apartment and in (hidden)ment if needed. The owner has another apartment in the same building on the ground floor (number 464) that can host 2 people and has a very nice large terrace with an outlook into green vegetation.

The apartment is very centrally located, near to the Museumsinsel, in a calm street with many different cosy restaurants just a few steps from the Spree riverbanks where one can walk and do jogging. The neighbourhood is very peaceful and green as there are many parks. The Koellnischer Park around the corner hosts the living symbol of Berlin - two brown bears. There are various lovely cafes and restaurants and all kinds of shops nearby the apartment, including a large bio market and an ordinary supermarket a 3-5 minute walk away. The stations Märkisches Museum, Heinrich-Heine and Jannowitzbruecke giving access to five major subway and train lines can be reached in 2-5 minute walk. It takes 5-10 minutes to walk to the historic Nikolaiviertel and to the Alexanderplatz (2 stops by subway). Boat trips through Berlin can be taken from the nearby riverbank. Despite its very central location the neighbourhood remains a peaceful haven away from urban noise and stress.

title: Frankfurter Allee, Berlin
description:
Charming and bright two bedroom apartment on the 6th floor (which can be reached comfortably by lift) within a beautiful classicism building from the 1950 ́s which is under monument protection. As you enter the spacious living area you`ll notice lots of art works on the walls as well a mix of vintag(hidden)ssic and modern furniture along wooden parquet flooring.Two large rooms are facing towards a quiet courtyard for a peaceful sleep. One master. bedroom and one, that can be used as a guest-, child- or office-room which includes a single bed, a huge desk and a nice collection of books. The fully equipped kitchen has an induction stove, oven, fridge/freezer combination, dish washer, microwave, juicer and coffee maker. The bathroom with tub is separate from the WC. An extra storage room is also available next to the dining area.

The apartment is located in the lively area of Friedrichshain, close to the subway station Frankfurter Tor. Besides that - Friedrichshain is called the new creative center of town - close to Kreuzberg, Neukoelln and Mitte. East Side Gallery, diverse Clubs, restaurants and galleries are within walking distance. Public transport U5-bahn subway are Frankfurter Tor and Samariterstr. You can take a walk to Boxhagener Platz and Simon-Dach-Str. which is famous for the flea market and food stalls on the weekends. There are also several tram stations nearby.

title: Strausberger Platz, Berlin
description:
Apartment on the 10th floor of a famous GDR landmark building on Strausberger Platz with views over Berlin. The one bedroom apartment is light flooded. In the living room there is a desk for home office, as well as a sofa to relax. The kitchen is open to the entrance area. The. bedroom has a queen size bed and a huge cabinet for clothes. 

Strausberger Platz connects the areas of Mitte, Friedrichshain and Kreuzberg and offers easy & fast access to all of them. Subway station is at your doorstep.

title: Belforter Straße, Berlin
description:
This bright and fully furnished 3-room apartment in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg offers 97 sqm of comfortable living space. It features a spacious bedroom with a king size bed, a large living room filled with natural light, a cozy couch, and a generous dining table—perfect for hosting dinners with friends or family. The third room can serve as a home office with a desk already in place, or be easily converted into a guest room with a sofa bed.

The apartment also includes a modern bathroom with warm wooden accents, a bathtub, and a washer/dryer. The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need for daily living and cooking, and a sunny balcony overlooking the quiet courtyard offers a peaceful spot to relax outdoors.

Situated in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, this apartment offers the perfect blend of vibrant city living and neighborhood charm. Surrounded by trendy cafés, restaurants, and local shops, the area is ideal for enjoying Berlin’s lively cultural scene. Just a short stroll away is the beloved Kollwitzplatz, home to the Thursday organic market, where you can find fresh, locally sourced produce, artisanal goods, and regional specialties. On Saturdays, the square transforms into a bustling food market offering a wide variety of international street food, handmade products, and seasonal treats—perfect for a relaxed weekend outing.

Excellent public transport options are within easy reach, making it simple to explore the rest of the city. And when you need a break from the urban buzz, green spaces like Volkspark Friedrichshain and Mauerpark provide peaceful escapes just around the corner.

title: Strausberger Platz, Berlin
description:
This cozy apartment in the lively district of Friedrichshain is on the 2nd floor and can be reached by lift. The bright one bedroom apartment receives plenty of natural sunlight through the south facing windows and is completely furnished with modern décor. The bedroom features a queen size bed. In the main living area you have a cozy sofa and a TV for relaxing movie nights. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you`ll need including dishwasher, stove and oven . The bathroom features a bath tub.

The apartment is located in Friedrichshain on the historical Strausberger Platz which is the border to Mitte. Not too far away you have plenty of restaurants, bars and cafés around. The shopping area is only a 2 stations away from the metro .

title: Rosa-Luxemburg-Straße, Berlin
description:
This designer apartment is perfect for those who appreciate quality and style. It features 4 rooms, including 3 bedrooms, and has been designed with attention to detail throughout. From the spacious living area to the modern kitchen and bathrooms, this apartment has it all. Plus, with a prime location in the city, it’s perfect for those who want to be close to the action. If you’re looking for a luxurious apartment that will make you feel right at home, this is the one for you

Located on Rosa-Luxemburg Strasse in the most active part of Mitte you will find everything you need a stone’s throw away including many restaurants, bars, cafes, and markets. Within walking distance of the apartment, you will find several tram lines and the U8 Rosa-Luxemburg-Platz station. That can quickly transport you to some of the hottest locations within Berlin.

title: Sredzkistraße, Berlin
description:
This charming 55 m2 one-bedroom apartment is located on the first floor in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg. Featuring a cosy living space with private balcony, a bedroom with a queen-size bed, and a fully equipped open-plan kitchen, it offers everything you need for comfortable city living. The apartment also includes a washing machine and a bathroom with a bathtub.

Located in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, one of Berlin's most sought-after neighborhoods, the apartment is surrounded by charming cafés, restaurants, boutiques, and green spaces. Excellent public transport connections provide quick access to the rest of the city, while nearby supermarkets, fitness studios, and everyday amenities are all within easy walking distance. The area combines a relaxed residential atmosphere with the vibrant energy that makes Berlin so unique.

title: Dresdener Straße, Berlin
description:
This stylish, fully furnished apartment combines distinctive interior design with everything needed for a comfortable stay. It features a welcoming living area with an open, fully equipped kitchen, a cosy bedroom with a king-size bed, a dedicated home-office space and a private balcony. The modern bathroom includes a spacious walk-in rain shower and a washing machine. Carefully selected furnishings, statement wallpapers and warm decorative details give the apartment plenty of character while keeping it practical and inviting.

The apartment is located in a lively and central neighbourhood between Mitte and Kreuzberg, close to Moritzplatz and Oranienplatz. The surrounding streets offer an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, bars and independent shops, while supermarkets and everyday amenities are also within easy reach. Nearby green spaces and the canals provide plenty of options for walking and relaxing, and excellent public transport connections make it easy to explore the rest of Berlin.

title: Weinbergsweg, Berlin
description:
This elegant three-room apartment on the second floor of a classic Berlin Altbau, combines original stucco details, high ceilings, and warm wooden floors with a stylish contemporary interior in natural tones and mustard-gold accents. Fully furnished and move-in ready, the apartment features a bright living room with a designer sofa, balcony access, and a separate dining room. The fully equipped kitchen provides everything needed for comfortable everyday living. Two bedrooms accommodate up to four guests, including one with a double bed and wardrobe and a second with a sofa bed, plus a dedicated home-office workspace. Two bathrooms offer added convenience, with one featuring a bathtub and the other a shower and WC. A sunny balcony overlooking both the courtyard and street completes this high-quality temporary home, ideal for executives, diplomats, project teams, and families.

Located in one of Berlin-Mitte’s most sought-after neighbourhoods, Weinbergsweg combines the energy of central Berlin with the charm of a leafy residential setting. Overlooking the beautiful Volkspark am Weinberg, the area is home to an exceptional selection of cafés, restaurants, bakeries, and boutiques, including popular favourites such as Daluma, Café Fleury, and renowned Italian dining spots. Rosenthaler Platz (U8) is just a short walk away, providing excellent transport connections, while the iconic Hackesche Höfe, the galleries of Auguststraße, and the vibrant restaurants, bars, and cultural venues of Torstraße are all within easy walking distance. This prime location offers the perfect balance of convenience, culture, and authentic Berlin character in the heart of Mitte.

title: Warschauer Straße, Berlin
description:
Life at Frankfurter Tor
521 apartments, 521+ students... be one of us & meet extraordinary people. Frankfurter Tor in Berlin Friedrichshain is a location that's all about being connected. Easily participate in our incredible community here and also absorb the retro-uniqueness of the neighborhood. With the tram, bus, and underground stops just outside our doors, getting to class and exploring Berlin is a breeze. Live in a cozy place with space to grow.

Our student community offers stylishly designed apartments for those who thrive on the energy of big cities. With us, you have a fully-furnished home complete with high speed wifi, gym, gaming areas, multimedia gaming room, 24-hour laundry, study areas and a very spacious community lobby. There’s also solid access to a diverse network of friends, events, and other amazing opportunities.

With 18 square meters of space, this apartment category covers your key needs while also providing a perfect place to unwind. Each apartment is standard equipped with great lamps and custom-designed furniture such as a comfortable bed, a wardrobe, a desk, a dining table, large noise isolating windows and a fully functional kitchen.
The elegant tiled bathrooms have custom designed faucets and a spacious shower.

Prices may vary depending on floor level, length of stay and rental period.

Included in your All-in rent: 
- Utilities (water, heating, electricity)
- fully furnished Apartment 
- high speed internet up to 1 Gbit/s 
- Community Areas, such as
   - Lobby with on-site staff
   - Laundrette
   - Study areas & Silent room
   - Gaming Areas with Kicker, Billiard, AirHockey, Ping-Pong
   - Gaming room with gaming console
   - Courtyards 
   - Gym 

As well as:
- Bicycle Storage 
- Front Office 
- Cashless-Payment Systems 
- Events 
- CCTV in the whole building for your Security 
- Security Service on Call in the night 

For each contract a security deposit of 2 all in rent applies as well as a one-time handling fee of 235.- €

Take a relaxed approach to deposit security. We have partnered with Garentii to offer a quick and comfortable solution. For a small fee, you can skip the deposit and save on upfront costs. Ready to say goodbye to deposits?

-----------------------------------------------

What happens after your booking is completed on HousingAnywhere?

Good to know: After your booking has been confirmed on HousingAnywhere, you have to finalize your reservation in our system. The following steps have to be completed:
1. You will receive a link to our website by e-mail.
2. On our website, you have to select the apartment type you have booked on HousingAnywhere.
3. As the next step, you will receive password-protected access to our app where you can upload your enrollment certificate, as well as a copy of your ID card or passport, and confirm the contract.
4. Afterward, we will check your details, and if everything fits you will receive an automatic e-mail with the payment request of the deposit and our one-off handling fee (this payment differs from the HousingAnywhere booking fee!).
5. As soon as there are no more pending payments (within the next 5 business days) and we have received the money, we will finalize the booking and you will receive a final confirmation e-mail.
6. Please note that the booking through our system should be completed no later than 7 days after booking on HousingAnywhere. After 7 days, the room is no longer reserved for you and can be booked by others. Just before the semester starts, reservations can only be held for 2 days. In this case, a refund of the costs paid so far is not guaranteed.

-----------------------------------------------

What lease terms are available and what is the deal with the 1 week early move out?

Depending on the property, you can choose between apartments with a minimum lease term of 6 to 12 months. However, during this rental period you must always be studying. Please note, the return of your apartment to us is one week before the end of the rental period, in order to be able to carry out cleaning, maintenance and repair measures necessary due to the use of the apartment and for a direct follow-up rental. We have calculated the rent on the basis of an effective term shortened by one week, so that this regulation does not represent an economic disadvantage for you. Of course, if you extend your stay with us and continue to reside in your apartment, no prior move-out is required between your old lease and your new lease.

title: Eisenbahnstraße, Berlin
description:
DUE TO A LOT OF REQUESTS PLEASE SENT ME A BOOKING REQUEST IMMEDIATELY!

Smart and sunny furnished Studio located in one of the most authentic and old buildings of Kreuzberg. With his old stripped pine floorboards and spacious high ceilings, the flat recalls the traditional Berlin architectural style.

The bedroom (2 windows) is furnished with a sofa-bed (150 x 200), a folding table and 4 chairs; the kitchen is equipped with all things that are necessary for cooking and eating, fridge/freezer, gas stove with 4 plates and oven.

The interior design combines vintage elements with old wood artistic furniture. Starting from the Kitchen and going through the bedroom until the entry, everything has been worked and created with old wood floorboards. It is the material that takes centre stage and the main material is the Upcycling wood. His design is elegant and understated. The aim is to mention the creative and alternative upcycling wood scene based in Berlin, which collect and convert waste or useless products (like historic floorboards of no more existing buildings) or old materials into something new and valuable. A new form, a new identity, a new life get by a patchwork of old elements.

The flat is located around the historic “Kreuzberg 36” and more exactly between the pretty Lausitzerplatz and the old Markthalle, now a new melting point for street food’s lovers. This part of Kreuzberg until 20 years ago was almost completely surrounded by the wall and for this reason, was also considered a no man’s land. A lot of pictures of the ’80s rap presenting desolation beside the wall have been made in those streets. Bright Studio Apartment on Comeniusplatz – Quiet Courtyard Location

Bright and charming studio apartment in a classic Berlin Altbau, quietly located directly on the beautiful Comeniusplatz in the heart of Friedrichshain. Featuring high ceilings, large original windows and plenty of natural daylight, the apartment combines the character of historic Berlin architecture with modern comfort. The thoughtfully furnished apartment is ideal for professionals, students and anyone looking for a comfortable temporary home in one of Berlin's most desirable neighborhoods.

The modern bathroom is equipped with a bathtub with shower, washbasin, toilet and washing machine.

Within just a few minutes' walk you will find supermarkets, bakeries, cafés, restaurants, pharmacies, organic food stores and a wide variety of local shops. * Passport or national ID card

title: Alfred-Jung-Straße, Berlin
description:
**For students, interns, and apprentices only!**

Welcome to our modern studio apartment, flooded with natural daylight and furnished with stylish wooden furniture. Inside, you'll find a compact kitchenette and a single bed, making efficient use of the available space. Plenty of storage solutions help maintain a tidy and comfortable living environment. Please note, however, that the kitchen does not include an oven.

Despite its peaceful atmosphere, everything you need is close at hand. Just a short walk away, you'll find numerous parks, a public swimming pool, and even a skate park, making Lichtenberg the perfect blend of urban convenience and residential charm.

The washing machine and dryer are shared with neighboring apartments, but they are available for use for a small fee.

As there are several similar apartments in the building, there may be slight differences between what you see in the photos and the apartment you ultimately rent.

The nearby Möllendorffstr./Storkower Str. tram stop is conveniently located just a 3-minute walk away and provides quick access to several tram lines (16, 21, M8, M10, and M13). In addition, Storkower Straße station, served by the S8, S9, S41, S42, and S85 lines, can be reached in a pleasant 13-minute walk.

Before proceeding with your application, please make sure you have the required documents ready:

* Passport or national ID card
* Current proof of enrollment at a university, or a letter of admission if you are a first-semester student
* Apprenticeship contract
* Internship agreement
* Language school enrollment contract covering the entire rental period

Please note that the mandatory broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag) is not included in the rent. In addition, the security deposit must be paid to us no later than 15 days before your move-in date.

We look forward to helping you make this studio your new home.

**Important!**

**Rental start date:** 1st or 16th of the month
**Rental end date:** 15th or last day of the month

Berlin, the dynamic capital of Germany, has firmly established itself as a city that seamlessly blends history, culture, and innovation. With its rich heritage, diverse population, and robust economy, Berlin has become a prime destination for individuals seeking a vibrant lifestyle while pursuing their educational and professional aspirations.

A Cultural Melting Pot: Berlin's allure lies in its diverse and inclusive atmosphere. It's a haven for artists, musicians, and creatives from all corners of the globe. The city's historic landmarks, such as the Brandenburg Gate and the Berlin Wall, stand as powerful reminders of its past while providing a backdrop for contemporary expression. Educational Excellence: Berlin boasts an array of prestigious universities and research institutions that draw students and academics from around the world. Institutions like Humboldt University and the Technical University of Berlin provide cutting-edge research opportunities and a wide range of study programs. The city's commitment to education is further exemplified by its affordable tuition fees and numerous scholarships available to both local and international students.

Professional Opportunities: As a global economic powerhouse, Berlin offers a plethora of professional opportunities across various industries. The city's startup ecosystem is particularly noteworthy, with its reputation as the "Silicon Allee" drawing tech entrepreneurs and innovators. The low cost of living in comparison to other major European cities further enhances its appeal, allowing individuals to balance a high quality of life with exciting career prospects.

Quality of Life: Berlin consistently ranks high on quality of life indices due to its excellent infrastructure, efficient public transportation system, and well-planned urban spaces. The city's green initiatives, extensive parks, and nearby natural landscapes provide ample opportunities for outdoor activities. A diverse culinary scene, bustling markets, and a myriad of cultural events ensure there's always something to explore and enjoy.

Cultural Exchange: The international makeup of Berlin's population fosters a rich cultural exchange, allowing residents to engage with people from all walks of life. This multicultural environment not only enriches personal experiences but also creates a dynamic backdrop for professional networking and collaboration.

Work-Life Balance: Berlin's relaxed atmosphere and work-life balance set it apart from other major metropolises. The city's emphasis on leisure and recreation ensures that individuals can pursue their passions outside of their professional commitments, contributing to a well-rounded and fulfilling lifestyle.

Berlin's unique blend of history, culture, education, and economic opportunities make it an exceptional city to live, study, and work in. Whether you're captivated by its artistic scene, intrigued by its academic offerings, or seeking a thriving career, Berlin offers a multifaceted environment that fosters personal and professional growth. title: Sonntagstraße, Berlin
description:
WHO WE ARE:
We are a start-up committed to solely hosting ambitious successful young professionals aged 21-35. We believe that hosting like-minded go-getters is essential for a pleasant flat atmosphere. With your relocation to Berlin to one of our luxurious co-living spaces, you will get direct access to an elite community of carefully selected individuals. You will instantly be integrated in Berlin’s social circle of bright rainmakers.

Renting a room with us can be compared to joining a selective membership club. Ultimately, our mission is to provide aspiring personalities like you, who are newly drawn to Berlin, with prompt communal cohesion and moreover with an extensive network of thriving achievers. Not just within your own co-living space, but also beyond your flat. On a periodical basis, we organize events, where tenants from different co-living spaces come together to enjoy an exciting evening and are moreover given a platform to network and bond. These events can be in form of fancy restaurant dinners, exclusive catered house-parties, long weekend lunches or even personalized pub crawls. Of course, with pleasure, we carry all costs of our highly valued get-togethers.

Regarding living comfort, we have established a new level of luxury in the co-living space segment. All our flats are equipped with the finest furniture highlighted by kingsized box-spring beds, modern fully fitted kitchens as well as all necessary appliances and utensils one might need in an apartment. Every flat of ours has been individually furnished with an eye for warmth and detail. Furthermore, we only choose prime locations for our apartments. Our shared flats can primarily be found in Berlin's most fancy and central residential area: Westend.

With us, the rent you pay is an all-inclusive rent. No headaches, no subsequent payments or hidden costs. Everything is included: electricity, very fast 100 Mbit/s internet, water, heating and washing machine costs. You also don’t have to worry about any administrative TO DOs like city registration for example. We will take care of everything. Moreover, we offer a 24/7 Community Member Service for any issue that may arise, may it be a simplerestaurant recommendation, city bureaucracy questions or any form of personal emergency.

We carefully select every member of our community and thus fully trust them; this is also why we are the only co-living player on the market that does not require a deposit. We believe that our non-deposit policy liberates our clients from unnecessary financial burdens and gives them more flexibility within their fast-paced career lifestyles.

YOUR ROOM:
The room is particularly bright with an amazing balcony. The room is equipped with a king-sized box-spring bed with fine bedding as well as two bedside tables, a chest of drawers, a large mirror, a working desk with a corresponding chair, a floor lamp and a large closet. In addition to your own room, you and your flat-mates share a spacious kitchen with a seating corner. The kitchen is fully equipped with cooking utensils and also has a washing machine. Furthermore, you can enjoy a spacious bathroom with a bathtub shower.

DEPOSIT:
To make your move easier, we offer flexible deposit options. You may choose between a one-time, non-refundable non-deposit fee of EUR 560, or a refundable security deposit of 3 months rent, which will be returned after move-out in accordance with standard regulations.

LOCATION:
The room is located in a very beautiful and well-maintained old building in the middle of the exclusive Berlin district Berlin Friedrichshain! Ideal for interns and young professionals, it takes only a few minutes by foot to the next metro station. More central is hardly possible! In addition, Friedrichshain in Berlin not only impresses with its central location, but also with its exclusivity and cool spirit. Restaurants and bars are within walking distance.

Please note:
- Please keep in mind that only the first month's rent is processed via the platform. All further rental payments and additional fees (e.g. cleaning fee, administration fee → check payment details) are processed outside the platform and must be paid by the tenant before the move-in date.

title: Mühlenstraße, Berlin
description:
*Dieses Apartment ist für maximal 2 Personen! Die zweite Person zahlt nur 50 Euro mehr.*
*Das Apartment liegt im Erdgeschoss des Wohnhauses*

Dein Zuhause in unserem Haus ist genau so individuell wie du selbst. Alle Apartments beinhalten volle Möblierung, Schlaf- und Wohnbereich sowie Küche und Duschbad. Sie sind durchweg hell, flexibel gestaltbar und bis ins letzte Detail durchdacht. Eine kluge Raumaufteilung, stilvolles Design und High Speed Internet lassen dabei keine Wünsche offen.
Das Gebäude steht in der Mühlenstraße, einer belebten Straße mitten in Pankow, unweit des Zentrums von Berlin. Die Gegend ist aufgrund ihrer Lage bei Studenten, Azubis, Pendlern und vor allem jungen Menschen sehr beliebt. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Restaurants&Bars, die Berliner City, vielseitige Natur und mehrere Uni-Campus sind schnell zu erreichen.

Waschmaschine (4 Euro pro Nutzung) und Trockner (2 Euro pro Nutzung) befinden sich im Waschsalon. 

The rent for the first month will be paid through HousingAnywhere. The deposit needs to be paid to us directly or via Housing Anywhere payments and should be received before the move-in date, in order to be able to receive the keys.

title: Köpenicker Straße, Berlin
description:
Exactly on the border of Mitte and Kreuzberg, located in the heart of graffiti-covered old murals, industrial views and a glimpse at the TV tower, K55 exudes everything that’s cool and sought after in Berlin. With hidden gems like Holzmarkt just across the river Spree or Schwarze Traube, a mesmerizing speakeasy just 10 minutes away, along with great lunch places all along Heinrich-Heine Straße, you’re always based at the perfect starting point for any new Berlin adventures. (Not to mention there’s a Späti right across the street with excellent service, should you get the cravings for midnight snacks or run out of milk for the morning.) 

Also located on site is a Berlin-style cafe which offers speciality coffee drinks, teas and much more. Tenants are able to receive a discount on items as well as use the container as a co-working space. Enjoy a coffee, quiet space and a place bump into your fellow

Transportation 
Heinrich-Heine-Straße (metro line U8) train station is 5-7 minutes away, Jannowitzbrücke is a 10 minute walking distance for all S-Bahn connection and Alexanderplatz is just across the river, or two stops away by train. 

Apartment 
Our bright and modern, fully furnished, one bedroom comes with a separate bedroom with a cozy Queen-sized bed, a bathroom with a walk-in shower, fully equipped kitchen with state-of-the-art amenities and a study area for when your creativity starts to burn the midnight oil. Keep in mind that international transfers can take a few business days so we suggest you to transfer the deposit as soon as you sign the contract.
In case that  you don't transfer the deposit on time, we'll have to cancel your reservation and you might loose the first month's rent.

Bornholmer Straße, located in the vibrant city of Berlin, holds a significant place in the history and identity of the German capital. Stretching through the neighborhoods of Prenzlauer Berg and Wedding, this street is renowned for its historical importance, especially as the site of the Bornholmer Straße border crossing during the times of the Berlin Wall.

The Bornholmer Straße border crossing gained worldwide attention on the fateful night of November 9, 1989, when the Berlin Wall fell. This crossing became the first to open its gates, allowing East Berliners to cross into West Berlin freely for the first time in decades. The momentous event marked the beginning of the end for the division of Germany and the Cold War era.

Today, Bornholmer Straße stands as a reminder of the city's turbulent past and its subsequent reunification. The site has undergone significant transformations since then, witnessing the growth and evolution of the surrounding neighborhoods. Prenzlauer Berg, in particular, has developed into a trendy district known for its artistic flair, lively atmosphere, and picturesque streets.

As visitors stroll down Bornholmer Straße, they can observe a mix of architectural styles, ranging from historical buildings that survived the war to modern constructions that reflect the area's contemporary spirit. The street is lined with cafes, boutiques, and local shops that cater to both residents and tourists, offering a diverse array of experiences.

Bornholmer Straße also intersects with various other important streets and public transportation options, making it a hub of connectivity within the city. Its accessibility adds to its charm and convenience, allowing residents and visitors to easily explore other parts of Berlin.

In conclusion, Bornholmer Straße in Berlin is more than just a street; it is a symbol of the city's history, resilience, and unity. From its pivotal role in the fall of the Berlin Wall to its present-day status as a dynamic urban center, this street encapsulates the spirit of Berlin's past, present, and future. Whether one is interested in history, culture, or simply experiencing the heartbeat of the city, Bornholmer Straße offers a captivating journey through time and a glimpse into the diverse tapestry of Berlin's identity.

Bornholmer Straße, located in the vibrant city of Berlin, holds a significant place in the history and identity of the German capital. Stretching through the neighborhoods of Prenzlauer Berg and Wedding, this street is renowned for its historical importance, especially as the site of the Bornholmer Straße border crossing during the times of the Berlin Wall.

The Bornholmer Straße border crossing gained worldwide attention on the fateful night of November 9, 1989, when the Berlin Wall fell. This crossing became the first to open its gates, allowing East Berliners to cross into West Berlin freely for the first time in decades. The momentous event marked the beginning of the end for the division of Germany and the Cold War era.

Today, Bornholmer Straße stands as a reminder of the city's turbulent past and its subsequent reunification. The site has undergone significant transformations since then, witnessing the growth and evolution of the surrounding neighborhoods. Prenzlauer Berg, in particular, has developed into a trendy district known for its artistic flair, lively atmosphere, and picturesque streets.

As visitors stroll down Bornholmer Straße, they can observe a mix of architectural styles, ranging from historical buildings that survived the war to modern constructions that reflect the area's contemporary spirit. The street is lined with cafes, boutiques, and local shops that cater to both residents and tourists, offering a diverse array of experiences.

Bornholmer Straße also intersects with various other important streets and public transportation options, making it a hub of connectivity within the city. Its accessibility adds to its charm and convenience, allowing residents and visitors to easily explore other parts of Berlin.

In conclusion, Bornholmer Straße in Berlin is more than just a street; it is a symbol of the city's history, resilience, and unity. From its pivotal role in the fall of the Berlin Wall to its present-day status as a dynamic urban center, this street encapsulates the spirit of Berlin's past, present, and future. Whether one is interested in history, culture, or simply experiencing the heartbeat of the city, Bornholmer Straße offers a captivating journey through time and a glimpse into the diverse tapestry of Berlin's identity.
