title: Langhansstraße, Berlin
description:
You live in a multi-family house with many children in an old building with charm and a green courtyard.

The spacious three-room apartment (83m2) in the front building is on the second floor.

The apartment is very bright. All rooms have an old wooden floor. The bathroom with bathtub and integrated shower with shower wall is tiled and has a window, therefore daylight.  The fitted kitchen is new.
 
The old building combined with modern furniture has a relaxed charm. 
One bedroom offers a large bed for two persons. 
The study has a sofa bed and can also be used as a youth room.
A small cellar belongs to the apartment.
In the house there is a bicycle cellar. 
.
Equipment
The old building flat with old wooden floor has a balcony to the green inner courtyard. 
The bathroom has daylight
The fitted kitchen is as good as new with stove, refrigerator, freezer, dishwasher, espresso capsule machine, toaster, kettle, iron.
There is a Smart Flatscreen TV. The washing machine is integrated in the kitchenette
Internet access is part of the rent
The final cleaning is included

Location
Just north of Prenzlauer Berg is Langhansstraße 

Trams no. 12 and 13 stop directly in front of the house.
No. 12 goes directly to the S-Bahn station Friedrichstraße, No. 13 goes to Warschauer Straße im Friedrichshain and into Wedding. 

The journey to Bahnhof Zoo (M13 and U9) takes about half an hour.

Alexanderplatz can be reached very easily with the M2 from Ostseestraße. 

Supermarkets, organic market, bakeries and smaller shops are in the immediate vicinity. Also cultural venues, such as the cinema and theatre in the Brotfabrik, Theater im Delphi are within walking distance.

The furniture is new and complete. Also the complete fitted kitchen. This is equipped with high-quality devices. 

Just arrive with your suitcase, go to the supermarket, do the shopping and start living. Have fun!

title: Löwestraße, Berlin
description:
Gemütliche kleine Wohnung in verkehrsgünstiger und in wirklich sehr ruhiger Lage. Die Wohnung ist möbliert und für 1 Erwachsenen  geeignet. Das Doppelbett (160x200 cm) und die Schlafcouch (160x200 cm) befinden sich im Wohnraum. Die Küche verfügt über ein Esstisch, Elektroherd, Kühlschrank, Waschmaschine etc. Das Bad ist mit einer Dusche ausgestattet. Fön ist vorhanden. 

Sie erreichen in ca. 200 m den U-Bahnhof Weberwiese (U5 - 4 Stationen bis zum Alexanderplatz). Der Ostbahnhof ist ca. 5 min mit dem Auto entfernt. In 300 m Entfernung fährt die Tram M10 direkt ins Zentrum des Prenzlauer Berges (Kulturbrauerei, U-Bahnhof Eberswalder Strasse). 
Die bekannte Karl-Marx-Allee (Stalinallee) ist von hier aus ca. 3 Minuten entfernt und entwickelte sich in den letzten Jahren zunehmend zur Geschäfts- und Restaurantmeile. Die bekannte Simon-Dach-Strasse, die Szenemeile des Friedrichshain, erreichen Sie in ca. 10 Minuten zu Fuss.

title: Große-Leege-Straße, Berlin
description:
The 2-room- apartment is a 54 square metre apartment in a residential building of the 1930s which has been totally renovated and modernized. Furnished in elegant Mediterranean style, is has an entrance, a living room with a loggia attached to it, a bed room, a fully equipped kitchen which can serve as dining room and a bath room. The apartment is on the third floor, calm and very bright and sunny – the living room, loggia and bathroom being oriented to the east, the kitchen and bedroom to the west. The floor is oak parquet in the living and bed room and tiles in the entrance floor, the bathroom and the kitchen. 
There is high speed internet access and wifi.
There is a lockable bicycle room in (hidden)ment of the house, which can be used by all residents of the house.

The apartment is situated in a quiet residential area with excellent acces to public transport (tramway 5 directly to Alexanderplatz and Hauptbahnhof).
There is a large beautiful parc with two lakes including a beach in 10 minutes walking distance (Obersee, Oberseepark, Orankesee).
A large supermarket, a bakery, drugstore and restaurants are located opposite the
apartment.
German, English, French and Russian spoken.
Please do not hesitate to contact us for any additional information or question.
The price of 1650 € is for 2 people, an additional person is +75 €/month.

title: Storkower Straße, Berlin
description:
Die schöne und lichtdurchflutete 2-Zimmer-Wohnung liegt im beliebten Berliner Bezirk Prenzlauer Berg. Die Wohnung ist für den täglichen Bedarf vollständig ausgestattet. Sie hat eine Größe von knapp 40 m2 und befindet sich in einem ruhigen Wohnviertel. Kostenlose Parkplätze findet man problemlos direkt vor dem Haus.
Vom Flur aus haben Sie Zugang zum Schlafzimmer (Doppelbett), Bad und modernem neu eingerichteten Wohnzimmer. Vom Wohnzimmer aus kommen Sie in die Küche.
Im Haus befindet sich ein Gemeinschaftsraum wo Sie Ihr Fahrrad sicher abstellen können.

Prenzlauer Berg hat sich von einem ursprünglich vernachlässigten Berliner Bezirk zum nachgefragtesten Berliner Kiez entwickelt. Zu Fuß erreichen Sie fast zahllose Restaurants, Bars und Cafes. Darüber hinaus befinden sich in der direkten Nähe mehrere Supermärkte und andere Einkaufmöglichkeiten. Einige Parks, 3 Schwimmhallen, Bowling etc. sind alle in wenigen Gehminuten zu erreichen.

Die Wohnung befindet sich am Rand der Berliner Innenstadt und ist sehr verkehrsgünstig gelegen. Der Bahnhof Greifswalder Straße ist nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt. Von dort gelangt man mittels S-Bahn (Linien 41, 42, 8, 85, 9) in das gesamte Berliner Stadtgebiet. Auch die Berliner Flughäfen sind von dort problemlos zu erreichen. Außerdem gelangt man von dort in 10 Minuten mit der Straßenbahn (Taktung: 3 – 5 Minuten wochentags) zum Alexanderplatz. Der Alexanderplatz bietet sich als Ausgangspunkt an, um die historische Mitte Berlins und somit die meisten Berliner Sehenswürdigkeiten zu Fuß zu erkunden.

The beautiful and light-flooded 2-room apartment is located in the popular Berlin district of Prenzlauer Berg. The apartment is fully equipped for everyday needs. It has a size of almost 40 m2 and is located in a quiet residential area. Free parking spaces can be found directly in front of the house.
From the hall you have access to the bedroom (double bed), bathroom and and modern newly furnished living room. You enter the kitchen from the living room.
There is a common room in the house where you can safely park your bike.

Prenzlauer Berg has developed from an originally neglected Berlin district to the most sought after Berlin neighborhood. You can reach almost countless restaurants, bars and cafes on foot. In addition, there are several supermarkets and other shops nearby. Some parks, 3 swimming pools, bowling etc. can all be reached in a few minutes on foot.

The apartment is located on the edge of downtown Berlin and is very conveniently located. The Greifswalder Straße train station is only a few minutes' walk away. From there you can take the S-Bahn (lines 41, 42, 8, 85, 9) to the entire Berlin city area. The Berlin airports are also easily accessible from there. You can also get to Alexanderplatz in 10 minutes by tram (3 to 5 minutes on weekdays). Alexanderplatz is a great starting point for exploring the historical center of Berlin and most of Berlin's sights on foot.

title: Holteistraße, Berlin
description:
Prime Location
This beautiful flat is located in the vibrant heart of Friedrichshain, right next to Ostkreuz, one of Berlin’s best-connected hubs. Just around the corner, you'll find unbeatable public transportation, including the S-Bahn, regional trains, and trams – all within walking distance. Reach the airport in just 15 minutes with a single stop!

A True Berlin Kiez Experience
Step outside, and you'll be immersed in one of Berlin’s most sought-after neighborhoods. From cozy coffee spots to bustling bars, trendy restaurants, and lively clubs, you’ll never run out of things to do. Shopping is a breeze with supermarkets like Penny, Aldi, Lidl, Rewe, and Bio Company all just a 5-minute walk away. If you're craving a bit of nature, the expansive Treptower Park, located along the water, is just around the corner – perfect for a relaxing stroll or morning run.

A Bright and Cozy Berlin Gem
The flat itself is a true gem, bathed in natural light throughout. The spacious living room features large windows that flood the space with sunlight. Plants and charming details like the wooden dining table add to its cozy ambiance, making it ideal for intimate dinners or relaxed evenings.

The living room also includes a comfortable sleeping couch, a TV, and a stylish coffee table. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need to cook a delicious meal, and the flat also includes the convenience of a washing machine.

The bathroom offers plenty of room, with a bathtub and a window, adding to the flat’s airy feel. The bedroom is a tranquil retreat, featuring a large wooden bed, an open closet, and a dresser for all your storage needs.

Industrial Charm
Designed in a stylish industrial theme, this flat offers the perfect blend of modern comforts and Berlin flair. Whether you're looking for a temporary home or an extended stay, this flat promises a welcoming and comfortable living experience in one of the city's most exciting neighborhoods.

Important Information: Balcony and Construction Notice
Please note that due to ongoing construction, the balcony is currently not accessible. While there is construction work happening outside the building, the windows are designed to keep out most of the noise, ensuring a peaceful environment inside the flat. We appreciate your understanding and are confident that this lovely space will still provide a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

title: Richard-Sorge-Straße, Berlin
description:
Live right in the heart of Friedrichshain – one of Berlin’s most exciting and loved neighborhoods. Whether you’re here to study, work, or just experience the city, this studio is the perfect place to start.

The vibe is simple, warm, and easy. Natural light fills the space during the day, and the layout makes it feel open but still cozy.

The apartment is bright, quiet, and fully furnished. It has a comfortable bed, a cozy sofa, and a fully equipped kitchen. The large wooden table and well-made chairs add to the feeling of space and comfort – whether you're having dinner, reading, or just taking a moment to unwind. It’s the kind of place that makes it easy to settle in, recharge, and feel at ease.

What truly sets this apartment apart is its unbeatable location. Nestled in the heart of Friedrichshain, you're just around the corner from Warschauer Straße, Boxhagener Platz, countless cafés, bars, and restaurants, and the beloved Volkspark Friedrichshain – perfect for a jog, a picnic, or just relaxing in the sun. With the S-Bahn (Ringbahn), tram lines, and the U5 metro at Frankfurter Tor all nearby, you're seamlessly connected to the rest of the city.

title: Erich-Boltze-Straße, Berlin
description:
🌿 Sun-Drenched & Flexible Living in the Heart of Prenzlauer Berg
Experience the ultimate Berlin lifestyle in this bright, fully furnished 2-room apartment. Located on a quiet, leafy residential street (Erich-Boltze-Straße), you are steps away from the iconic Volkspark Friedrichshain and the trendy cafes of Prenzlauer Berg.

🏠 The Space: Your Home, Your Rules
This isn't just an apartment; it’s a flexible living concept. Whether you are a couple, a group of friends, or a professional needing a dedicated home office, the layout adapts to you:

✅ Flexible Setup: Use the rooms as a classic Living Room + Bedroom, or as two separate private Bedrooms for a shared living arrangement.
✅ Fully Equipped: Move in with just your suitcase. The apartment is thoughtfully furnished to ensure maximum comfort and a "homey" feel from day one.
✅ Light-Filled: Large windows ensure the space is energized by natural light throughout the day.

📍 Location: The Pulse of Berlin
You are situated in one of Berlin’s most desirable pockets. Everything you need — from late-night Spätis to high-end organic supermarkets — is within walking distance.

✅ Nature at your doorstep: Just an 8-minute walk to Volkspark Friedrichshain for jogging, picnics, or open-air cinema in the summer.
✅ Commuter’s Dream: * Tram M4: Only 10 minutes to Alexanderplatz (the heart of the city).
✅ S-Bahn Greifswalder Straße: Instant access to the Ringbahn (S41/42) to reach any corner of Berlin fast.
✅ Education & Work: Perfectly positioned for students and researchers:
~12 mins to Humboldt University.
~18 mins to TU Berlin.

📋 Simple & Transparent Terms
✅ Occupancy: The base price is optimized for up to 2 people (ideal for couples or singles).
✅ Additional Guests: To keep utility management simple, a fee of €100/month applies for each additional person more than 2

Why this apartment?
While most central apartments are noisy, Erich-Boltze-Straße offers a peaceful sanctuary without sacrificing the "Berlin buzz." You get the prestige of a Prenzlauer Berg address with the convenience of a Friedrichshain social life.

title: Hauptstraße, Berlin
description:

Looking for the perfect balance between Berlin’s vibrant energy and a peaceful retreat? This fashionable 2-room apartment in the sought-after Rummelsburg district offers stunning views, modern comforts, and unbeatable proximity to the city's heart.

Step into a space designed for relaxation and productivity. Flooded with natural light thanks to floor-to-ceiling windows, this home feels airy and expansive.
✅ Living Area: Relax with a large flat-screen TV and high-speed Wi-Fi.
✅ The View: A large private balcony overlooking the Rummelsburger See. Start your morning with birdsong and coffee, or wind down with a sensational sunset view over the water.
✅ Bedroom: Quiet and cozy, featuring a comfortable double bed for a perfect night's sleep.
Fully Equipped: From a modern kitchen to all essential amenities—just bring your suitcase.

📍 Location & Lifestyle
Located in Rummelsburg (Lichtenberg), you are right on the border of Friedrichshain.
✅ Connectivity: You’re a 2-minute walk from public transport. Ostkreuz, a major transit hub, and the Rummelsburg S-Bahn are just moments away.

✅ Occupancy: The listed price is for up to 2 guests. For each additional guest, a fee of €100/month applies.

It’s rare to find a "quiet" Berlin apartment that is also this well-connected. Whether you're a professional looking for a peaceful home office or a couple wanting to experience the Berlin lifestyle without the noise of the main strip, this is it

title: Ebertystraße, Berlin
description:
46 m2 is a lot of floor for a studio, and it shows. On Ebertystraße the bed, the desk and the sofa each have a corner of their own instead of competing for the same wall, so sleeping, working and switching off stay properly apart. The apartment is modernised, fully furnished and livable from the first day.

A comfortable double bed and a generous wardrobe make up the sleeping side; a desk, a sofa bed and a 4K television the living side. The fitted kitchen is fully equipped, dishwasher and washing machine included, and the bathroom is modern with a walk-in shower. Built-in storage in the hallway keeps suitcases and coats out of sight. Bed linen, towels and crockery are there, and so is fast wifi.

Service charges, heating, electricity and internet are already part of the rent – no separate contracts, no bill at the end of the year, no waiting for a connection. The apartment is let for stays of three to twelve months, with city registration at this address.

Highlights

+ 46 m2 – unusually generous for a studio
+ Fully furnished and ready for a long stay
+ Electricity, heating, service charges and fast wifi included
+ Fully equipped fitted kitchen with dishwasher
+ Washing machine in the apartment
+ Double bed and sofa bed, sleeps two
+ Desk and 4K television
+ Built-in storage in the hallway
+ City registration possible

Location

The Nordkiez is the quieter half of Friedrichshain. Ebertystraße itself is residential, between Landsberger Allee and the Hausburgviertel, with the neighbourhood life starting around the corner: supermarkets, bakeries and corner shops on the street, cafés, bars and restaurants around Bersarinplatz and towards Frankfurter Allee. Hausburgpark with its playground and sports grounds is a short walk away; Volkspark Friedrichshain, with its fairy tale fountain and open-air cinema, about fifteen minutes. The Ring-Center on Frankfurter Allee covers the bigger shopping trips, while the Velodrom and Max-Schmeling-Halle host concerts and sport nearby.

Short distances in every direction: S-Bahn Landsberger Allee is about five minutes on foot and combines the Ringbahn (S41/S42) with the S8 and S85. Trams M5, M6, M8 and 18 stop at the same station and reach Alexanderplatz in roughly 15 minutes. The M10 towards Prenzlauer Berg runs from Landsberger Allee/Petersburger Straße, and the bars around Boxhagener Platz are a few tram stops south.

title: Corinthstraße, Berlin
description:
Very bright,  urban style, dream apartment in vibrant Kreuzberg-Friedrichshain, with balcony Facing south, close to Rummelsburg bay.

Sehr helle, individuelle Traumwohnung im pulsierenden Friedrichshain, nahe der Rummelsburger Bucht im Altbau mit Südbalkon

The 2 room apartment is located on the third floor of a charming historic building from the 1920s, located in a quiet side street within the vibrant area of Friedrichshain. 

You will enter the apartment and will realize how bright and cosy your new home is. It is a welcoming, comfortable place, that provides all you can wish for, while staying in Berlin, for a few months or even a full year. The apartment is equiped with fast internet WIFI, which makes it also home office location.

The living room, kitchen and bedroom are facing the south. All rooms are funished in a cosy scandinavian style, with hand selected furniture and art from Berlin and around the world

One major highlight of the apartment is for sure the living room, which is bright and very cosy, furnished with mid century furniture and original art pieces, many books, a record player and a table for 4-6 friends for a visit.
 
The kitchen which has been completely renovated in December 2022, has large windows towards the south. It offers high quality new appliances: induction oven, dishwasher, kettle, large fridge/ freezer, cookware, high quality cutlery, toaster and a coffee and tea maker.
It's a nice spot to stay for hours enjoying the sun,  the view and your cup of coffee and tea.

The balcony is for sure another sweetspot of the apartment, facing the historic buildings on the other side of the Corinth Street. Its equipped with a table, two chairs and an umbrella for sunny Berlin days.

Through the corridor you can also enter the bedroom, which offers a king-sized bed, a spacious antic wardrobe, a nice workbench and chair.

Bed linen, blankets, pillows, ironing machine and ironing board are provided. 

Very practical is the small, but seperated storage room, where important items like vacuum cleaner, the ironing board and other practical tools and items are stored.

In the bathroom you will find the sink, a shower, a WC and a washing machine.

THE LOCATION
Friedrichshain is a vibrant and very creative area, famous for its bars, clubs and cafes. In the last years many new international employers have opened their offices in this area, like the "Media Spree" and  Universal, MTV, Coca Cola, die fernsehwerft and others. 

If you leave the apartment you will reach the "Ostkreuz" Station, one of Berlin's major transportation hubs within 11 minutes by walk (3 minutes by bike). From there you will reach the new BER airport within 20 minutes, the Alexander place (city center) within 9 minutes and the Brandenburg gate within 17 minutes. Several trains (S-Bahn) and bus lines will take you from there to any point in Berlin and around.

For all your favourite outdoor activities you will find the perfect sport right at your doorstep. The river Spree with its waterfront promenade is just one block away. If you prefer jogging, cycling or sailing, paddeling or swimming the Rummelsburger Bucht (bay) is just 14 minutes by foot or 4 minutes by bike away. Also the large and beautiful city park (Treptower Park) is just one kilometer away.

If you are heading to Kreuzberg, you just need to pass the Oberbaum bridge and you will be able to enjoy the bars, cafes and lifestyle of the this exciting neighbouring area (18 minutes walk, 5 minutes by bike)

title: Frankfurter Tor, Berlin
description:
Welcome to our stunning duplex apartment, where light floods every corner and panoramic views of the city's rooftops await you. This beautiful, completely renovated maisonette apartment on the fifth floor in Frankfurter Tor enjoys the sun all day long and impresses with a panoramic view of the Frankfurter Tor crossing.  

Nestled in the heart of Friedrichshain, this centrally located gem accommodates up to four guests comfortably. 
Experience the charm of city living from this unique vantage point, where modern design meets historic allure. 
With its spacious layout and thoughtful touches, this duplex offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience for your urban escape.

Ascend to the fifth floor and step into the hallway of our apartment, where natural light floods the space, creating a welcoming atmosphere from the moment you arrive. 

To your right, you'll find the kitchen where you can indulge your inner chef in our fully equipped kitchen. Bask in the warm sunlight streaming through the windows as you brew your morning coffee. 

You'll find all the amenities you need to whip up delicious meals, from pots and pans to utensils and cutlery, as well as a coffee maker, stove, oven, and microwave, all seamlessly integrated into the stylish design of the space.

To your left, you'll discover the bathroom, equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. Whether you prefer a refreshing shower or a relaxing soak in the tub, you'll find both options available. Additionally, a washing machine is provided for your convenience, and fresh towels await you.

As you step through the doors of this stunning apartment, you're greeted by the heart of the space: a cozy corner seating area. 

From here, you can seamlessly transition into the inviting living room, complete with a large comfortable sofa which easily can be transformed into a sofa bed if you are traveling as a group of four. It also counts with a television including Apple TV, and a spacious dining table for four.

Ascend the stairs to discover a dedicated working area which boasts the best view, providing a picturesque backdrop for productivity and inspiration, a charming balcony offering rooftop views, and a bedroom for two adorned with a cozy chair for moments of relaxation.

The spacious bedroom offers ample room to unwind, complete with a sizable wardrobe and large windows that flood the space with invigorating morning light.

Within a brief 5-10 minute walk from the apartment, you'll find an array of grocery shopping options and multiple convenient corner stores (Spätis). 

Immerse yourself in the authentic Berlin experience as the area offers a diverse selection of charming and trendy cafes, international restaurants, and vibrant bars and nightclubs. 
Just a street crossing away, you'll discover the renowned Simon-Dach Kiez, Boxhagener Strasse, and the RAW area. Be sure to explore our guide for culinary recommendations!

The newly renamed Uber Arena, formerly known as the Mercedes-Benz Arena, is just a 20-minute walk away. With its plethora of concerts and sports events, it's a must-visit destination. Plus, you'll also find the iconic East Side Gallery nearby, adding to the allure of the area.

The apartment enjoys excellent access to public transportation, with Frankfurter Tor station being only a few steps away from the apartment. From here, you can easily access the metro (U5) and tram (M10) lines, making getting around the city a breeze.

Key destinations:

Alexanderplatz: 4 metro stops, a quick 6-minute ride on the U5.

Brandenburger Tor: 8 metro stops, a 10-minute journey with the U5.

Hauptbahnhof: 10 metro stops, a 13-minute ride with the U5.

Adjoining rooms can be partitioned for privacy and accessed via a corridor. The apartment is fully furnished with cozy old-world charm, and houses an extensive library on international art and design, as well as contemporary artworks by international artists on loan from the collection of a prominent Berlin gallery. 

High-speed wireless internet is provided. Additional storage space is available in a private secure unit in the basement. A parking permit can be issued for free street parking. 3 supermarkets, dry cleaners, gyms, children's playgrounds, and many other amenities located within a couple of blocks of the apartment. Within 10 minutes you can get to Boxhagener Platz or Kollwitz Platz, Volkspark Friedrichshain (a lovely public park), Alexander Platz, and in 30-40 minutes you will arrive at the main train station or the airport thanks to trams and city trains (M10, M5,6,8, Ring S-Bahn 41 and 42).  

The flat is on the 4th floor, in the back building and thus very quiet. It is part of a traditional Berlin building with high ceilings, wooden floors and is fully furnished. The bills for electricity, gas, water and internet are included in the rent. There is a wide choice of supermarkets and health food stores near by. At less than 10 minutes walk there are an olympic indoor swimming pool, a hospital, medical center, restaurants , cafes and bakeries. 

There is no dedicated parking, on-street parking, however, is free. 

The apartment consists of a hallway with mirror, shoe rack and wardrobe hooks. It leads to the bathroom with shower, toilet, sink, shelves, a clothes bin and the main room: here there is a generous table that doubles up as a desk, 2 chairs, a wardrobe, two big shelves and a few smaller wall-mounted shelves, a comfortable couch chair, and black-out curtains. From the main room you enter the kitchen with fridge-freezer, dishwasher, hob, microwave, washing machine and shelves and storage units. There are bedding, towels, and crockery. In (hidden)ment there is a storage locker and there is dedicated space to park bikes.

Zentral und hell, grün und doch mitten im Berliner Getümmel. Hier hast du alles, was du braucht, in unmittelbarer Nähe, dank des nahe gelegenen Verkehrsknotenpunktes : in 10 Minuten bist du sowohl am Boxi oder Kollwitz Platz, im Volkspark Friedrichshain,  im Schwimmbad, am Alex, oder in 30-40 Minuten sowohl am Hauptbahnhof oder als auch am Flughafen. (M10, M5,6,8, Ring-S-Bahn 41 und 42). Die voll möblierte Wohnung ist in einem traditionellen Berliner Altbau mit hohen ZImmerdecken und Holzboden. Strom, Gas, Wasser und Internet sind in der Miete enthalten.

Diese Wohnung ist im 4.Stock im Quergebäude gelegen und somit sehr ruhig, gleichzeitig gibt es von Rewe Supermarkt bis zum Biomarkt, mehreren Bau- und Supermärkten, Klinikum, Ärztehaus, einem Volksbad, Restaurants, Cafes und Bäckereien in 5-10 Minuten zu Fuß Entfernung alles was man im täglichen Leben braucht.

The bedroom is equipped with a comfortable double bed, a large closet and a television. The living space includes a sofa that opens into a bed, a television, a dining area and a fully equipped kitchen.
The property is located in the trendy neighborhood in Berlin - Prenzlauer Berg. A neighborhood that young people and families like to live in, an established neighborhood with lots of excellent cafes and restaurants. The charming and sunny design apartment is freshly renovated and lovingly furnished - a haven of well-being in the heart of Berlin.  

The sun-filled spacious living room invites you to relax on the sofa or have a cozy brunch with friends at the dining table. From spring to autumn, you can spend relaxing hours on the balcony, which overlooks the quiet, green bicycle street. On cool days, the fireplace creates a cozy atmosphere.  

The bedroom is equipped with a comfortable king-size bed (1.80m x 2m) and a spacious wardrobe (about 6m wide). Additionally, the apartment is suitable for daily work in the home office, as it has a desk and free Wi-Fi (50 Mbps).  

From the living room, you enter the bright, fully equipped kitchen with a Nespresso machine, gas stove, oven, and large fridge-freezer. The spacious daylight bathroom features a bathtub with a shower screen, a hand basin, mirrored cabinet, toilet, and washing machine.  Characteristic of a Berlin old-style apartment, the living and bedroom are adorned with beautiful stucco. The living and bedroom, as well as the hallway, have wooden floorboards, while the bathroom and kitchen are tiled.  There is a shared garden in the backyard which can be used by all tenants.   


The location:  The apartment is located in the trendy Komponistenviertel in Weißensee, right on the border to the popular Prenzlauer Berg. Weißensee is a livable, green, yet vibrant district with many shopping opportunities, restaurants, and cafés.  Within a 5-minute walk, you can reach Lake Weißensee with numerous leisure and recreational facilities, such as cafés, a beach bath, various playgrounds, and boat rental. Within walking distance, there are numerous shopping options (e.g., Edeka, Netto), organic stores (e.g., Denn's Biomarkt, Biocompany), cafés, restaurants, and a cinema.   

By tram (a 3-minute walk), you can reach S-Bahnhof Greifswalder Straße (Ring-Bahn with various connections) in 5 minutes and S- and U-Alexanderplatz in 15 minutes.

- Fully equipped, modern kitchen:

The apartment is located in the lively yet quiet district of Berlin-Friedrichshain. This attractive location offers excellent connections to numerous facilities for daily needs as well as green spaces that are ideal for recreation and leisure activities.
Shopping facilities and pharmacies:
Supermarkets: a REWE supermarket is located just 350 meters away and can be reached on foot in about 5 minutes. Another large shopping center, the East Side Mall, is about 2.5 kilometers away and can be reached in about 10 minutes by bike.
Pharmacies: The nearest pharmacy (Friedrichshainer Apotheke) is only 300 meters away, which corresponds to a walk of about 4 minutes. Other pharmacies are located along the nearby Frankfurter Allee, which is about a 10-minute walk away.
Restaurants:
Italian, Japanese, German, bars, etc. within 10 minutes walking distance
Healthcare facilities:
Hospitals: Vivantes Klinikum im Friedrichshain is only 1.5 kilometers away and can be reached in about 20 minutes on foot or in 5 minutes by bike. There are also numerous doctors' surgeries in the immediate vicinity, for example near the Samariterkiez, which can be reached on foot in around 10 minutes.
Parks and recreational facilities:
Volkspark Friedrichshain: Volkspark Friedrichshain, one of the largest and oldest parks in Berlin, is around 1.2 kilometers away and can be reached on foot in around 15 minutes. Here you can relax in a green oasis, do sports or take a leisurely stroll.
Forckenbeckplatz: This smaller park is only 300 meters away from the apartment, which corresponds to a walk of about 4 minutes. Forckenbeckplatz offers green spaces for relaxing breaks and a playground for children.
Fitness studios
Superfit: (5 min walk)
Fitness First (5 min walk)
Public transportation:
Dolziger Straße 33 has excellent connections to the public transport network. The Samariterstraße subway station (U5) is around 500 meters away and can be reached on foot in less than 7 minutes. From here you can reach the city center and other important transport hubs quickly and easily.
Summary: The apartment complex offers a perfect blend of urban convenience and natural recreation. Shopping facilities, pharmacies, medical care and bars and restaurants are all within a short distance, while the proximity to large parks such as Volkspark Friedrichshain also offers residents numerous opportunities for relaxation and leisure activities. An ideal location for couples or individuals who want to enjoy life in the city to the full.

title: Dolziger Straße, Berlin
description:
Wohnung:
Wir vermieten unsere wunderschöne, helle 3-Zimmer-Wohnung im Samariterkiez in Berlin-Friedrichshain. Die Wohnung verfügt über zwei voll ausgestattete Badezimmer, von denen eines mit einer Badewanne ausgestattet ist, die sich ideal für entspannte Stunden eignet. Ein besonderes Highlight ist der nach Süden ausgerichtete Garten, der mitgenutzt werden kann. Bei Sonnenschein strahlt die Sonne direkt über die Terrasse in eines der Schlafzimmer sowie in die Wohnküche.

Die Wohnung ist ein moderner Neubau, was sich in der hochwertigen Ausstattung widerspiegelt. In allen Zimmern und Bädern ist eine Fußbodenheizung installiert, die für eine gleichmäßige und angenehme Wärme sorgt. Eines der Zimmer nutzen wir derzeit als Arbeitszimmer, aber dank einer vorhandenen Futonmatratze kann es bei Bedarf auch als Schlafzimmer verwendet werden.

English:
We are renting out our beautiful, bright 3-room apartment in the Samariterkiez neighborhood of Berlin-Friedrichshain. The apartment features two fully equipped bathrooms, one of which includes a bathtub, perfect for relaxing. A particular highlight is the south-facing garden, which can be shared. On sunny days, the sunlight streams directly through the terrace into one of the bedrooms and the open-plan kitchen and living area.

The apartment is a modern new-build, reflected in its high-quality furnishings. Underfloor heating is installed in all rooms and bathrooms, ensuring a consistently comfortable and cozy temperature. One of the rooms is currently used as an office, but thanks to an existing futon mattress, it can also be used as a bedroom if needed.

Lage:
Der Samariterkiez, im östlichen Teil Berlins im Stadtteil Friedrichshain gelegen, zeichnet sich durch seinen entspannten, familiären Charakter aus. Hier treffen historische Altbauten, grüne Straßen und eine lebendige Nachbarschaft aufeinander, wodurch Urbanität und Ruhe harmonisch vereint werden. Dieser Charme macht das Viertel sowohl für Familien als auch für junge Berufstätige und Studierende attraktiv.

Die sanierten Altbauten mit großzügigen Wohnungen und Balkonen prägen das Bild des Kiezes. Zahlreiche Kitas, Schulen und Spielplätze sowie der Forckenbeckplatz mit seinen Grünflächen unterstreichen die Familienfreundlichkeit des Viertels. Rund um die Samariterstraße und Frankfurter Allee laden gemütliche Cafés, Restaurants und Bars zum Verweilen ein, während die hervorragende Anbindung mit der U-Bahnlinie U5, Tram- und Buslinien den Kiez mit dem Rest der Stadt verbindet. Auch für den täglichen Bedarf und ausgedehnte Shoppingtouren ist gesorgt, etwa entlang der Frankfurter Allee oder im Ring-Center.

Friedrichshain selbst gehört zu den spannendsten und vielfältigsten Stadtteilen Berlins. Die East Side Gallery, ein künstlerisch gestalteter Abschnitt der Berliner Mauer, und das RAW-Gelände mit seinen Galerien, Clubs und Street-Food-Märkten spiegeln die kreative Seite des Viertels wider. Grüne Oasen wie der Volkspark Friedrichshain oder die nahegelegene Spree bieten Erholung und Freizeitmöglichkeiten. Zudem ist Friedrichshain für sein pulsierendes Nachtleben bekannt, das von weltberühmten Clubs wie dem Berghain bis zu gemütlichen Bars reicht.

Mit seiner zentralen Lage, die den einfachen Zugang zu Kreuzberg, Mitte und Prenzlauer Berg ermöglicht, ist Friedrichshain ein idealer Ort für alle, die das urbane Berliner Lebensgefühl erleben möchten. Die multikulturelle Nachbarschaft und die offene, dynamische Atmosphäre machen den Stadtteil besonders einladend, sowohl für Einheimische als auch für Zugezogene.

English:
The Samariterkiez, located in the eastern part of Berlin in the district of Friedrichshain, is characterized by its relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere. Here, historic buildings, tree-lined streets, and a vibrant neighborhood come together, harmoniously combining urban life with tranquility. This charm makes the area appealing to families, young professionals, and students alike.

Renovated historic buildings with spacious apartments and balconies define the neighborhood's appearance. Numerous daycare centers, schools, playgrounds, and the Forckenbeckplatz with its green spaces emphasize the family-friendly nature of the area. Around Samariterstraße and Frankfurter Allee, cozy cafés, restaurants, and bars invite visitors to linger, while excellent transport connections via the U5 subway line, trams, and buses link the neighborhood to the rest of the city. Daily necessities and extended shopping options are well covered, with spots like the Frankfurter Allee and the Ring-Center nearby.

Friedrichshain itself is one of Berlin's most exciting and diverse districts. The East Side Gallery, a section of the Berlin Wall now adorned with impressive artwork, and the RAW grounds, featuring galleries, clubs, and street food markets, highlight the district's creative side. Green spaces like the Volkspark Friedrichshain or the nearby Spree River offer opportunities for relaxation and leisure. Friedrichshain is also renowned for its vibrant nightlife, ranging from world-famous clubs like Berghain to cozy bars.

With its central location, providing easy access to Kreuzberg, Mitte, and Prenzlauer Berg, Friedrichshain is an ideal place for anyone looking to experience Berlin's urban lifestyle. Its multicultural neighborhood and open, dynamic atmosphere make the district particularly inviting for both locals and newcomers.

The fully furnished apartment is located about 2 kilometers from Berlin Alexanderplatz. It's a two room apartment with one bedroom, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom with a shower.
The apartment is located at the top floor (7th floor, elevator) of the buildings  in the famous Karl Marx Allee. 
The place is recently renovated and newly furnished. All the rooms have wooden floors.  From the spacious entre hall you have access to all rooms of the apartment. Right next to the entrance is the newly designed bathroom with a rainshower and high quality appliances by Villeroy and Boch. 
The kitchen is fully equipped with all the necessary kitchen gear, has a dishwasher, a microwave and locates the washing machine too. There is a small sitting area to have breakfast. 
The living room is located facing the Strausberger Platz with a gorgeous view of the unique architecture of the Karl-Marx- Allee, that is an ensemble of buildings that are now under monumental care.
The bedroom is located in the back of the building.  Besides a double bed, a generous closet with lots of drawers and storage space, the room offers a small working area too.
The next Subway Station (Line 5, Stop: Strausberger Platz) is a two minutes walk away.

title: Korsörer Straße, Berlin
description: Quite & cosy 2 -Room Apt. with oven and open shower in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg. fully furnitured with a unique mixture of Art Deco 20th century and Scandinavian mid century. The apt. is close to Mauerpark, located between Schönhauser Allee and Gesundbrunnen. With short access to S Bahn, To FEX - Rapid Train to the airport a Regional Trains into beautiful countryside. the Korsörer Straße is part of the "Gleimkiez", of North Berlin, situated in one of the last "eastern parts" of the City, where you can finde the last not-resaturated Houses of Berlin. And also very modern architecture side by side. in the Mauerpark you are free to lay on the ground, play soccer or Basketball, listen to street Music or take part of the Big karaoke Show. Find souvenirs at the Sunday fleamarket or take some spray Colors to put some Graffities on the accent part of the Wall. Fell Free to go out to plenty of bars and Restaurants nearby without being disturbed by loud music too close to you.

description:
**A quiet home in the heart of Friedrichshain: lively streets outside, a calm courtyard retreat inside**

This spacious, fully furnished L-shaped studio with a loft-like feel sits right in the middle of Friedrichshain, just 20 meters from Simon-Dach-Straße and 70 meters from Revaler Straße. Boxhagener Platz, RAW, the Sunday markets, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and bars are all a short walk away. Tram, S-Bahn and U-Bahn are close by, so getting anywhere in the city is quick.

**Great through the winter months**
The neighborhood keeps its energy all winter long. Even on the greyest days you're minutes from a cozy café for a slow breakfast, restaurants for every taste, bookshops, bars and weekend markets. The streets stay busy all year, so you'll never feel stuck indoors. When you'd rather stay in, you come home to a warm, peaceful apartment that feels like your own place, not a temporary rental.

**Quiet, comfortable and ready for everyday life**
The apartment faces the inner courtyard, so it's remarkably quiet for such a central spot. Previous tenants valued this very much. Inside you'll find exposed brick, thoughtful design details and a warm, characterful feel, plus everything you need day to day:

- Fully equipped kitchen for real cooking, not just reheating
- Spacious bathroom with a powerful shower
- Washing machine
- Extra bedding and pillows
- Kept spotless, with a reputation for cleanliness among previous tenants

**Who it's perfect for**
One person or a couple looking for a furnished home for 3–6 months, right in the middle of Friedrichshain's everyday life.

title: Frankfurter Tor, Berlin
description:
Welcome Home
Located directly at Berlin's iconic Frankfurter Tor, this bright, fully renovated 93 sqm apartment combines the architectural character of one of the historic Stalinallee buildings with contemporary comfort. Three versatile rooms, two private balconies, and a fully furnished interior create a home ready to move into.

Completely renovated in 2026 and fully equipped, the apartment is ideal for stays of several months.


A Walk Through the Apartment
Stepping inside, you'll find a practical entrance area with a separate storage room for coats, shoes, and everyday essentials.

To your right, the first room overlooks the quiet west-facing courtyard. Two large windows fill the room with afternoon light, while a comfortable double bed and a dedicated workspace create a peaceful place to live and work.

Straight ahead, you'll enter the apartment's largest room. Large west-facing balcony doors fill the space with afternoon and evening light and open onto the balcony overlooking mature trees and the peaceful courtyard. Thoughtfully furnished for living, working, and relaxing, the room easily adapts to different lifestyles, whether used as a spacious living room, a second bedroom, or both.

Returning to the entrance area, a hallway to the right leads to the bathroom, kitchen, and third room.

The bathroom, compact as is typical of the historic Frankfurter Tor buildings, features a spacious walk-in rain shower, a vertical heated towel rail, a large washbasin, a wall-mounted toilet, and a discreetly integrated washer and dryer, making excellent use of the available space.

Next to it, the bright kitchen welcomes the morning sun through two large east-facing windows with electric shutters. From the kitchen, you look across the long balcony towards Frankfurter Tor and the monumental architecture of Karl-Marx-Allee.

The third room enjoys private access to the long east-facing balcony. Furnished with a single bed, a dedicated workspace, and a Smart TV, it serves equally well as a bedroom, living room, or home office. Electric shutters provide excellent blackout whenever needed.

All three rooms are fitted with quiet ceiling fans, providing comfort throughout the year.

The apartment's flexible layout allows the three main rooms to adapt easily to different needs and lifestyles, making it equally suitable for individuals, couples, or colleagues sharing the apartment.


Life at Frankfurter Tor
Frankfurter Tor offers a unique combination of historic architecture, excellent transport connections, and everyday convenience. Located in the heart of Friedrichshain, you'll be living in one of Berlin's most dynamic neighborhoods, where its iconic architecture blends with a lively mix of cafés, restaurants, cultural venues, and local businesses.

Everything you need for daily life is within walking distance, including supermarkets, bakeries, pharmacies, fitness studios, language schools, and cafés. Just a few minutes away, Volkspark Friedrichshain offers one of Berlin's finest parks for jogging, relaxing, and enjoying the outdoors.

Excellent public transport makes getting around Berlin easy. Berlin Central Station is just 14 minutes away via the direct U5 line, while BER Airport can be reached in around 40 minutes with a single transfer.

The nearby MediaSpree business district, home to companies such as Amazon, Zalando, and Universal Music, as well as numerous technology, consulting, and creative businesses, is just a short bike ride or a few stops by public transport away.


At a Glance
•	93 sqm fully furnished apartment
•	Fully renovated in 2026
•	Three versatile rooms with flexible living and working space
•	Top-floor apartment with no direct neighbors above
•	Registration (Anmeldung) available
•	High-speed Wi-Fi and utilities included
•	Two private balconies
•	Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher and full-size fridge-freezer
•	Spacious walk-in rain shower
•	Washer & dryer
•	Real oak parquet flooring
•	Electric shutters in the east-facing rooms
•	Quiet ceiling fans throughout the apartment
•	Modern insulated windows
•	Bicycle storage
•	Optional car parking (additional charge)
•	Communication available in English, German, Brazilian Portuguese and French


Ideal For
•	Executives & Expats
•	Consultants & Remote Professionals
•	Visiting Academics & Researchers
•	International Students & Language Students


Accessibility
The apartment offers step-free access. Please note that the balconies have door thresholds. The bathroom is compact and therefore not suitable for wheelchair users.


House Rules
This apartment has been thoughtfully renovated and furnished to create a comfortable home. We are looking for tenants who will appreciate it and treat it with care and respect.
•	Strictly non-smoking (including both balconies)
•	No parties or events
•	Please keep noise to a minimum between 10:00 pm and 7:00 am
•	Respect the neighbors and the building's quiet residential atmosphere


Rental Conditions
•	Minimum stay: 3 months
•	All-inclusive rent (utilities and high-speed Wi-Fi included; fair usage policy applies)
•	Advertised rent applies to up to 4 occupants
•	Additional occupants upon request (additional charges apply)

•	Registration (Anmeldung) available
•	Corporate rentals welcome

title: Schivelbeiner Straße, Berlin
description:
Cozy, bright flat with high ceilings in the charming neighbourhood of Prenzlauer Berg near Mauerpark. Surrounded by shops, cafes and great restaurants, with U-Bahn, Ringbahn, and tram just steps away. Renovated with premium furniture and textiles, the space features a serene minimalist aesthetic—perfect for relaxing or exploring Berlin.

The newly renovated and stylishly furnished apartment can accommodate up to 4 people and has a separate kitchen, and bathroom with extra large shower. The central location close to Schönhauser Allee (3 stops to Alexanderpl.) offers numerous cafes, restaurants and excellent transport links – ideal for exploring Berlin.

Perfect for city travelers, or small families who appreciate comfort and want to be in the middle of the action.

The space
This charming apartment is located in trendy Prenzlauer Berg, one of Berlin's most popular neighborhoods. Surrounded by numerous bars, restaurants and shopping, the area offers everything a traveler may need. The subway and S-Bahn stations are within easy walking distance, so you can explore the city quickly and easily.

The apartment is located in an old-town family house with high ceilings (about 3 m) and has recently been freshly renovated. A stylish and well thought out room layout awaits you on about 40 square meters.

The living room has a living, sleeping area, with a comfortable sofa bed that can acomodate 2 people.

The separate built-in kitchen is fully equipped and leaves nothing to be desired. It has a ceramic countertop, a 4 plate induction hob, an oven, a dishwasher, a large fridge with 3 freezer compartments, a washing machine and a dryer. In addition, all the necessary kitchen appliances such as kettles, toaster, and french press for coffee are at your disposal. High-quality dishes, glasses and complete equipment with cooking utensils ensure a successful cooking experience. A comfortable table in the kitchen offers space for up to 4 people.

The modern bathroom boasts high-quality fixtures and materials, and features en extra large shower space that offers added comfort. A window provides natural light and fresh air. Various shower utensils are available.

The apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay in Berlin – perfect for a relaxed temporary home in one of the most exciting cities in Europe!

Die Wohnung bietet zudem ausreichend Stauraum für persönliche Gegenstände. Ergänzt wird die Ausstattung durch High-Speed-Internet, einen Smart-TV, ein Smart-Lock-System sowie Originalgemälde, die der Wohnung einen individuellen, künstlerischen Akzent verleihen. 
Es ist eine nicht Raucher Wohnung.

Küche und Wohnbereich sind nach Osten ausgerichtet.

Das Wohnhaus sowie der Innenhof befinden sich in einem gepflegten Zustand. Das stilvolle Treppenhaus überzeugt durch Stuckdetails und kunstvolle Mosaikarbeiten. Ein Aufzug sorgt für zusätzlichen Komfort.

1-Room Apartment on Schivelbeiner Straße – Stylishly Renovated and Available for 4 to 8 Months with an option to extend.
The one-room apartment is located on the 4th floor (side wing) of a representative Gründerzeit-style multi-family building. All living areas feature original Berlin floorboards, painted in light gray, giving the apartment an elegant and warm atmosphere. The interior bathroom is fully tiled in white and includes a bathtub.

The modern apartment has been completely new renovated and fully furnished. The kitchen is fully equipped with a refrigerator with freezer compartment, sink, 4-burner induction cooktop, oven, kitchen cabinets, washer-dryer, and a complete set of kitchen utensils. An extendable dining table is available for meals, while a separate desk in the living area can be used for work. The apartment also offers ample storage space for personal belongings. Additional features include high speed internet,  a smart portable TV, smart lock system, and original paintings that give the apartment a unique, artistic touch.
It is a non smoking apartment.

The kitchen and living area face east.

The building and the inner courtyard are well maintained. The stylish staircase impresses with stucco details and decorative mosaic work. An elevator provides additional convenience.

Die Wohnung im Seitenflügel liegt ruhig im Innenhof einer von einer Promenade gesäumten Straße, unweit des S-Bahnhofs Schönhauser Allee. Die Anbindung an das öffentliche Verkehrsnetz ist ausgezeichnet: Mit der U-Bahn ist man in wenigen Minuten am Alexanderplatz, auch der S-Bahnhof Schönhauser Allee ist 5 Minuten entfernt.
In der Umgebung gibt es zahlreiche Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Neben großen Einkaufszentren wie den Schönhauser Allee Arkaden findet man viele kleine, individuelle Läden, einen beliebten Biomarkt sowie verschiedene Discounter, darunter auch ein Rewe-Supermarkt an der Ecke.
Die Wohngegend gehört zu den begehrtesten in Berlin und ist durch ihre stetig wachsende Kulturszene ein besonderer Anziehungspunkt.

This charming apartment in the side wing is peacefully tucked away in the courtyard of a tree-lined promenade street, just a short walk from Schönhauser Allee S-Bahn station. Public transport connections are excellent: the U-Bahn takes you to Alexanderplatz in just a few minutes, and the Schönhauser Allee S-Bahn station is easily accessible as well.
The neighborhood offers a wide range of shopping options. In addition to the large Schönhauser Allee Arkaden shopping center, you’ll find numerous boutique stores, a popular organic market, and various discount supermarkets, including a Rewe just around the corner.
One of Berlin’s most desirable residential areas, this location is particularly attractive thanks to its vibrant and ever-growing cultural scene.

🚍 Public Transport

title: Lottumstraße, Berlin
description:

💙 Located in Lottumstraße in a historical 19th century building it offers everything you need for easy and comfortable living in Berlin: 

🎯 Hackescher Markt, Alex or Rosa-Luxemburg-Platz are just few minutes walk away, trendy Kastanienallee or Weinbergspark are just around the corner; 

🌳 Bright (3rd floor) and amazingly quiet apartment facing large green backyard and sleepy Lottumstrasse. Stays cool also when it is 30+ outside; Smart lay-out with three large rooms with sufficient space for a couple or young family with a kid:

- Airy bedroom with king size bad, large wardrobe & workplace corner 
- Study/children's/guest room or a second bedroom with comfortable coach & workplace 
- Fully furnished kitchen with balcony 
- Bathroom with shower and washing machine. 

Enjoy small details that will make your stay in Berlin unforgettable: Altbau-flair with wooden floors and beautiful staircase, morning coffee on the balcony overlooking an old chestnut and chilling or barbecue in the backyard. The apartment has been newly renovated and lovely decorated. The house is on the border between Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg, on the quiet Lottumstrasse, between Teutoburger Platz, Weinbergspark and Torstrasse. 

In just a few minutes you are at the subway stations Rosenthaler Platz or Rosa-Luxemburg-Platz. Hackescher Markt and Alexanderplatz are also within walking distance. From designer shops and galleries to cafés and bars to fitness, museums and theaters, all everyday amenities are within easy reach.

title: Fehrbelliner Straße, Berlin
description:
Entire apartment for exclusive use (no shared rooms). The apartment is ideally suited for up to two people (either single person or couple).

A beautiful, spacious, and light-filled duplex apartment in one of the most sought-after areas of Berlin-Mitte, directly on the border with Prenzlauer Berg.

The fully furnished apartment spans the 3rd and 4th floors of a Wilhelminian-era building from the early 20th century. It features one bedroom as well as two additional rooms.

The upper level comprises a bright living room and a generous bathroom with an extra-large bathtub, a separate shower cabin, and a window.

The living room offers a large plasma TV with HDMI connection and a spacious, exceptionally comfortable sofa that invites you to relax.

On the lower level, you’ll find an additional living and dining room with an integrated library area, a bedroom with a workspace, and a generous kitchen with an additional dining or work table that seats up to four people.

The fully equipped kitchen includes a dishwasher, a freestanding refrigerator with a large freezer compartment, an oven, a gas cooktop, and a sink.

Wi-Fi and a SONOS sound system in four rooms are available. A washing machine is also provided.

All rooms benefit from natural daylight, including four large French windows with small balconies, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere.

The apartment is located in an absolutely central area of Berlin-Mitte. Just around the corner is one of the liveliest neighborhoods between Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg, offering numerous cafés, bars, and restaurants for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

The popular Kastanienallee, Rosenthaler Platz, and Hackescher Markt are all just a 3–10 minute walk away—on foot, of course.

Despite its central location, the apartment is situated in a very quiet and peaceful neighborhood, as the street in front of the building is traffic-calmed (bicycle street and 30 km/h zone, no traffic-light intersection).

An organic food store, supermarkets, discount stores, drugstores, bakeries, and late-night convenience shops (“Spätis”) are all within a 5-minute walk. Long opening hours make daily and last-minute shopping easy and convenient.

The spacious two-room flat features a large bedroom, a bright and inviting living room, a fully equipped kitchen, a modern bathroom, a storage room, and a sunny south-facing balcony. Classic Berlin Altbau details such as stucco ceilings and wooden floorboards add warmth and character to the space.

The location is exceptional: the S-Bahn stations Bornholmer Straße, Schönhauser Allee, and Gesundbrunnen are all within walking distance, offering excellent connections throughout the city. The typical Berlin-style covered south-facing loggia provides the perfect spot to relax after a day in the city.

Prenzlauer Berg is known for its charming cafés, lively atmosphere, and central position. Famous landmarks such as Alexanderplatz with the TV Tower or the Brandenburg Gate can be reached quickly by public transport. On weekends, the popular Mauerpark—just a 5-minute walk away—invites visitors with its well-known flea market and legendary Sunday karaoke.

Experience Berlin like a true local — right in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg.
It’s simply knorke!

title: Rochstraße, Berlin
description: This apartment offers you everything to feel at home immediately at the heart of Berlin (S-Hackescher Markt). From the 12th floor you look out over the city, which is at your feet. Countless restaurants, sightseeing places, cultural venres, museums as well as bars are within 5 minutes walking distance. The studio has a fully equipped open kitchen. There is a microwave, kettle, toaster and nespresso coffee machine and everything you need to cook. The dining area is for three people. The comfortable double bed has a size of 140x200. The living room is equipped with flat screen TV (can be connected to Netflix), as well as 5G internet. You can store your clothes on the free-floating clothes rail with hanging device. The bathroom with tub has automatic ventilation, a hairdryer and a washing machine. A storage room opposite to the flat provides extra space for lugguges to keep the flat tidy. We also offer options for regular cleaning. This costs 75€ on weekdays and 85€ on weekends. New towels and new bedding (for 2 persons) cost additional 29,5€. All prices are exclusive of VAT.

title: Holzmarktstraße, Berlin
description:

Ich biete eine voll möblierte, gemütlich eingerichtete, Ein-Zimmer-Wohnung mitten im Zentrum von Berlin (ca. 5 Gehminuten zum Alexanderplatz) Bad, WC, TV, Waschmaschine, Klingelanlage mit Gegensprechanlage, Fernwärme im Neubau mit Lift, Fahrradparkplatz vor dem Haus und Fahrradabstellraum im Haus, Wachschutz usw. usf.
Die Wohnung ist neu renoviert, mit komplett neu eingerichter Küche

title: Matternstraße, Berlin
description:
From 1 July 2026, we will be subletting our apartment located on Matternstraße (Friedrichshain) as we will be moving abroad for a limited period. The apartment is not suitable as a shared flat (WG) and is ideal for single occupants or couples looking for a high-quality home in a very good location.
The apartment offers 78 sqm of living space and a true highlight: a spacious rooftop terrace of approx. 32 sqm with panoramic views over all of Berlin – perfect for sunny evenings, working from home or relaxed weekends.
The sublease will be limited until the end of February 2027. 
The apartment has a great layout and immediately feels like home. Thanks to its many windows and elevated position, all rooms are bright and filled with natural light. The atmosphere is very cozy, making it easy to settle in quickly. The neighbors and house community are very pleasant.
A particular highlight is the rooftop terrace, which faces the rear building and is therefore extremely quiet – no street noise, no traffic. A perfect retreat right in the heart of the city.
If you are interested, feel free to contact us at any time at (hidden).
Best regards & have a lovely day 🌞
Franca & Kilian

description:

title: Elisabeth-Mara-Straße, Berlin
description:
This extraordinary apartment in Berlin Mitte captivates with its opulent furnishings and unique details. The entrance area welcomes you with artistic floral wallpaper and black-and-white marble flooring that underscores the luxurious character of this 110 m2 apartment on the 3rd floor. An elegant guest WC with speakeasy charm completes the first impression. The elevator provides convenient access to this representative apartment in the front building.

The centerpiece is the master bedroom with golden wallpaper, leading to a spacious walk-in closet and a marble bathroom for two with shower. The thoughtful room layout maximizes the available space across 110 square meters and creates a harmonious living atmosphere within three rooms. The fully equipped fitted kitchen features a Nespresso coffee machine, dishwasher, fridge-freezer combination, and modern hob with complete crockery and cutlery. The adjacent dining area offers direct access to the 10 m2 balcony, creating additional outdoor living space and channeling natural light into the living areas. The glamorous living room surprises with a built-in cinema including projector and screen, plus Apple TV and Netflix for premium entertainment. Continuous real wood flooring and modern underfloor heating ensure comfortable living throughout all rooms and highlight the high-quality construction of this 2015-built building. A practical washer-dryer, stereo system, and internet flat rate complement the amenities, along with high-quality bed linen, covers, and towels. The bicycle cellar provides additional storage space for your personal belongings, while a hairdryer ensures daily comfort. The generous window fronts allow abundant daylight to enter and create a bright, welcoming atmosphere throughout all living areas, while the two bathrooms with their marble fittings guarantee maximum comfort.

Elisabeth-Mara-Straße is located in the vibrant heart of Berlin Mitte, just a few minutes' walk from Unter den Linden and Brandenburg Gate. Excellent transport connections with several U-Bahn stations nearby make all districts quickly accessible. This furnished apartment is ideal for discerning business travelers and expats seeking temporary living with exceptional comfort.

title: Heinz-Kapelle-Straße, Berlin
description:
Entire apartment
The Apartment

Be the first tenant to enjoy this freshly upgraded 51 m2 apartment in a Berliner Altbau. This is a first-time occupancy after a full refreshment and complete furnishing.

The Highlights

- Brand new kitchen: Nobilia kitchen equipped with German Bosch appliances (Stove, Oven, Dishwasher).

Privacy & Comfort

Location: Heart of Prenzlauer Berg

- Walking distance to the popular Bötzowkiez with its vibrant cafes, restaurants, and organic supermarkets.

- Minimum stay: 6 months.

- All-inclusive: Heating, electricity, water, and internet are included in the monthly rent.

title: Choriner Straße, Berlin
description:
A spacious 148 m2 Altbau beletage apartment on the border of Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg. A real Berlin home with five rooms (three bedrooms), a generous living area, and one and a half bathrooms. It comfortably suits a family or a couple. The interiors keep the best of the building's classic Altbau character including high ceilings, wooden floors, and large windows. The design-led kitchen has been featured in interiors magazines and is fully equipped for daily cooking.

The location
You are right on the Mitte/Prenzlauer Berg border, arguably the best of both: the calm, leafy, family-friendly streets and café culture of Prenzlauer Berg, with the galleries, restaurants, and central convenience of Mitte minutes away. Supermarkets, bakeries, playgrounds, (international) schools, and excellent restaurants are all within a short walk. A calisthenics park sits right next door, and the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Sportpark is just around the corner, offering a running track, tennis courts, and a basketball arena that hosts German league games, perfect if you like staying active or watching live sport. Connections across the city are superb, the closes stop is Eberswalder Str. (U2, M1, M10)

title: Prenzlauer Allee, Berlin
description:
Cozy and bright 1 bedroom apartment in the best neighborhood of Berlin. 
Fully furnished kitchen, living room, bedroom, and work station. Centralized heating, washing machine and dishwasher. 
Location: In the area there are many coffee shops, bakeries, restaurants, supermarkets (Lidl/Edeka/DM), and pharmacy. 
Connectivity: Tram M2 is right down. 10min by Tram or 25min walking to Alexander Platz SBahn/Ubahn and Prenzlauer Berg SBahn.

title: Kopenhagener Straße, Berlin
description:
I am offering my fully furnished and lovingly designed apartment in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg for approximately 3–4 weeks in July. The apartment is bright and spacious, featuring two balconies, high ceilings, and a carefully curated interior with designer furniture and thoughtful details throughout. The fully equipped kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, and comfortable living spaces make it ideal for both remote work and everyday living.

The apartment offers a calm and welcoming atmosphere while providing all the comforts needed for a short stay in Berlin. It is best suited for one person or a couple looking for a temporary home rather than a holiday rental.

Located in one of Berlin’s most desirable neighborhoods, the apartment is surrounded by beautiful cafés, restaurants, bakeries, boutiques, and local markets. Despite being in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, the area is quiet and residential.

Excellent public transport connections provide quick access to Mitte, Kreuzberg, Charlottenburg, and other parts of the city. Popular green spaces such as Mauerpark and Volkspark Friedrichshain are within easy reach, making it a wonderful base for enjoying Berlin in the summer.

I am looking for a responsible, respectful, and tidy tenant who will enjoy and care for the apartment during my absence. The rental is available for a fixed period in July only.

When reaching out, please include a short introduction about yourself, your occupation, and what brings you to Berlin during this time. Professionals, creatives, researchers, consultants, and expats are especially welcome.

title: Bornholmer Straße, Berlin
description:
🇩🇪 Wohnungsbeschreibung (Deutsch)

Stilvolle 2-Zimmer-Wohnung mit Loft-Charakter im Herzen von Prenzlauer Berg

Diese außergewöhnliche 2-Zimmer-Wohnung verbindet großzügiges Raumgefühl mit urbanem Wohnkomfort. Die beeindruckende Deckenhöhe von ca. 5 Metern verleiht der Wohnung einen einzigartigen Loft-Charakter und sorgt gemeinsam mit den großen Fenstern für eine helle und freundliche Atmosphäre.

Die Wohnung befindet sich in einem ruhigen und gepflegten Innenhof und bietet damit eine angenehme Wohnqualität – mitten in einem der beliebtesten Stadtteile Berlins. Die moderne Einbauküche, das großzügige Badezimmer sowie der hochwertige Bodenbelag machen die Wohnung sofort bezugsfertig.

Ob möbliert oder unmöbliert – die Wohnung kann flexibel an Ihre Bedürfnisse angepasst werden. Eine Anmeldung ist möglich und auch eine langfristige Anmietung ist willkommen.

Die Lage überzeugt durch ihre hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung: Die S-Bahn-Station Bornholmer Straße erreichen Sie in nur etwa fünf Gehminuten. Straßenbahn und Bus halten direkt vor der Tür. Zahlreiche Cafés, Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sowie Parks befinden sich in unmittelbarer Umgebung.

Highlights auf einen Blick

* Ca. 66 m2 Wohnfläche
* 2 Zimmer
* Ca. 5 m Deckenhöhe mit Loft-Charakter
* Ruhige Innenhoflage
* Moderne Einbauküche
* Großzügiges Badezimmer mit Dusche
* Optional möbliert
* Anmeldung möglich
* Langfristige Anmietung willkommen
* Abstellraum vorhanden
* Parkmöglichkeiten direkt vor dem Gebäude
* Hervorragende Anbindung an S-Bahn, Tram und Bus

⸻

Stylish 2-Room Apartment with Loft Character in the Heart of Prenzlauer Berg

This unique two-room apartment combines spacious living with modern comfort. The impressive ceiling height of approximately 5 metres creates a distinctive loft atmosphere, while the large windows fill the apartment with natural light throughout the day.

Located in a quiet and well-maintained courtyard, the apartment offers a peaceful living environment in one of Berlin’s most sought-after neighbourhoods. A modern fitted kitchen, spacious bathroom and high-quality flooring make the apartment ready for immediate move-in.

The apartment is available either furnished or unfurnished, allowing you to choose the option that best suits your needs. Registration (Anmeldung) is possible, and long-term rentals are welcome.

The location offers excellent public transport connections. Bornholmer Straße S-Bahn station is only about a five-minute walk away, while tram and bus stops are located directly in front of the building. Supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, parks and boutiques are all within easy walking distance.

Key Features

* Approx. 66 sqm living space
* 2 rooms
* Approx. 5 m ceiling height with loft character
* Quiet courtyard location
* Modern fitted kitchen
* Spacious bathroom with shower
* Available furnished or unfurnished
* Registration (Anmeldung) possible
* Long-term rental welcome
* Storage room available
* Parking spaces directly in front of the building
* Excellent connections to S-Bahn, tram and bus

title: Mariannenplatz, Berlin
description:
Welcome :)

First things first: Anmeldung (address registration) is possible, and the contract is open-ended (unbefristet).
Super beautiful Kreuzberg studio with a stylish bathroom in a prime location right by the quiet Mariannenplatz – yet close to the vibrant Oranienstraße, Görlitzer Park, the Landwehrkanal, and Engelbecken.
The apartment is located in a well-maintained residential complex overlooking the beautiful Mariannenplatz. In the heart of Kreuzberg, right on the historic Mariannenplatz, this freshly modernized 1-room apartment awaits you. Compact, ergonomically designed, and featuring a cozy balcony facing the greenery, this apartment offers the perfect urban oasis. The building is equipped with an elevator and boasts excellent energy efficiency (Class C).
The apartment is in top condition. It features underfloor heating, electric shutters, a built-in kitchen (EBK), and a very beautiful bathroom.


Vorweg: Anmeldung möglich.

Super schönes Kreuzberg Studio mit schickem Bad in bester Lage am ruhigen Mariannenplatz, aber dennoch nah an der pulsierenden Oranienstr., dem Görlitzer Park, Landwehrkanal oder Engelbecken.

Die Wohnung befindet sich in einer gepflegten Wohnanlage mit Blick auf den schönen Mariannenplatz. Mitten im Herzen von Kreuzberg, direkt am geschichtsträchtigen Mariannenplatz, wartet dieses frisch modernisierte 1-Zimmer-Apartment auf Sie. Kompakt, ergonomisch durchdacht und mit einem gemütlichen Balkon ins Grüne bietet diese Wohnung die perfekte urbane Oase. Das Gebäude verfügt über einen Aufzug und beste Energieeffizienz (Klasse C).

Die Wohnung ist top in Schuss. Mit Fußbodenheizung, elektrischen Rolläden, Einbauküche und sehr schönem Bad.

description:

title: Voigtstraße, Berlin
description:
Welcome to your dream apartment in the hip cultural district of Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg. This exquisite 3-bedroom apartment offers not only an optimal location, but also high-quality equipment and modern comfort.

This apartment is designed with high quality materials to create an open, light-filled character. The new and modern designed eat-in kitchen features top of the line appliances and is the ideal place to enjoy time with friends and family or prepare delicious meals.
