title: Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Straße, Berlin
Gubener Straße, Berlin
description:
Diese wunderschöne 35,13 m2 große Wohnung im Hochparterre des Vorderhauses in der Gubener Str. , 10243 Berlin -Friedrichshain wurde 2025 umfassend kernsaniert und wird nun erstmals voll möbliert angeboten.

Die 2-Zimmer-Wohnung verbindet Altbau-Charme mit modernem Wohnkomfort: hohe Decken, originale Holz-Doppelkastenfenster, ein separates Schlafzimmer sowie ein klar strukturierter Wohn- und Essbereich. Das hochwertige Badezimmer überzeugt mit begehbarer Dusche, Mikrozement und modernen Armaturen.

Alle Nebenkosten sind im Mietpreis enthalten – inkl. Heizung, Strom, Internet und GEZ (Rundfunkbeitrag).

Anmeldung beim Bürgeramt ist selbstverständlich auch möglich.


English translation:
This beautiful 35.13 m2 apartment on the raised ground floor of the front building at Gubener Str., 10243 Berlin-Friedrichshain was comprehensively renovated in 2025 and is now being offered fully furnished for the first time.

The 2-room apartment combines classic old-building charm with modern comfort: high ceilings, original wooden double-casement windows, a separate bedroom, and a well-structured living and dining area. The high-quality bathroom impresses with a walk-in shower, elegant microcement finishes, and modern fixtures.


All ancillary costs are included in the rent – incl. heating, electricity, internet, and GEZ (German broadcasting fee).

Official registration at the local residents office is of course possible.

title: Landsberger Allee, Berlin
description:
Available furnished from September 1, 2026, for stays of three months or longer.

Completed in 2024, this 74 m2 apartment offers a level of finish and comfort rarely found in Berlin rentals. It has two bedrooms, two full bathrooms, carefully designed workspaces, underfloor heating throughout, and high-quality sound and thermal insulation.

The west-facing primary bedroom includes generous wardrobe space, a compact work desk, remote-controlled blackout blinds, and a private bathroom with both a walk-in shower and bathtub. The east-facing second bedroom features a large desk with electric height adjustment, making it ideal as a bedroom and comfortable home office, as well as additional storage for clothes and linens.

The bedrooms and living room are fitted with remote-controlled dimmable lighting, with adjustable color temperature from warm to cool light. Both bathrooms have heated towel rails, while high-quality windows and doors provide excellent insulation from outside noise and changing temperatures.

The fully equipped kitchen includes a cooktop, oven, microwave, refrigerator, and separate freezer. A dedicated laundry area features a washer-dryer, retractable drying rack, and sound-insulated walls with anti-vibration protection.

The east-facing balcony is reached through a large sliding glass door and is a pleasant spot for breakfast or morning coffee.

The condominium fee and utilities are included in the monthly rent.

title: Berolinastraße, Berlin
description:
Bright, modern 2-room apartment (~60m2) on the top floor of a 2017 building, south-facing with a balcony. Located right by Jannowitzbrücke/Alexanderplatz — quiet despite the central location, with U-Bahn, S-Bahn, and tram all nearby. Heating, internet, and electricity included.

Anmeldung (registration) possible. 
Initially offered as Zwischenmiete, with possible Nachmieter handover.

title: Eberswalder Straße, Berlin
description:
Fully furnished 3-room apartment with balcony in Prenzlauer Berg – from September 1, 2026

This stylishly furnished apartment with approx. 89 sqm is located on the 3rd floor of a fully renovated historic building in one of Berlin’s most sought-after neighborhoods, Prenzlauer Berg.

The apartment offers a well-designed layout with a living room, bedroom, guest/study room, kitchen, bathroom with bathtub, storage room, and balcony. A cellar compartment can be made available upon request.

The apartment was extensively renovated two years ago and is fully furnished. It includes sofas, table, chairs, a high-quality box-spring bed (180 x 200 cm), washing machine, and a fully equipped kitchen.

WiFi included.

Ideal for corporate stays / relocation

Monthly rate 2100 Euro plus utility charge (electricity, heating...) 330 Euro. Complete rate: 2430 Euro.

Available from: September 1, 2026
Minimum rental period: 6 months

title: Kleine Alexanderstraße, Berlin
description:
Die Neubau Wohnung liegt sehr zentral am Alexanderplatz in der kleinen Alexanderstraße. Obwohl es nur wenige Schritte zum Alexanderplatz und zum Bahnhof Alexanderplatz sind, ist die Lage absolut ruhig und nicht eingeengt. Die Erdgeschosswohnung verfügt über eine Terrasse mit Nordausrichtung und eine größere Terrasse und EIGENEM Garten mit Südausrichtung. Zentraler und ruhiger geht es kaum.
Die Einrichtung ist komplett löffelfertig eingerichtet. Alle Möbel und Haushaltsgegenstände sind enthalten. Sie bringen Ihren Koffer mit, alles andere ist bereits vorhanden.

Aufteilung:
Wohnzimmer mit integrierter Einbauküche und Zugang zu Terrasse und Garten Abstellkammer mit Waschtrockner Arbeitszimmer mit Boxspringsofabett, auch als Kinder- oder Gästezimmer nutzbar, Zugang über Wohnzimmer Badezimmer mit Dusche Schlafzimmer mit zusätzlichen Wannenbad Elektrische Jalousien und Fußbodenheizung in allen Räumen

Die Anlage ist sehr gepflegt und verfügt über einen Doorman- und Hausmeisterservice. Der Innenhof ist begrünt und repräsentativ. 

English:
The flat is very centrally located at Alexanderplatz in the Kleine Alexanderstraße. Although it is only a few steps to Alexanderplatz and to Alexanderplatz station, the location is absolutely quiet and not cramped. The ground floor flat has a north-facing terrace and a larger terrace and OWN south facing gardenl It could hardly be more central and quiet.

The furnishings are completely ready to move in.
All furniture and household items are included. You bring your suitcase everything else is already there.

Layout:
Living room with integrated fitted kitchen and access to terrace and garden Storage room with washer-dryer Study with box-spring sofa bed, can also be used as a children's or guest room, access via living room Bathroom with shower Bedroom with additional bathroom with bathtub Electric blinds and underfloor heating in all rooms



The complex is very well maintained and has a doorman and caretaker service. The inner courtyard is landscaped and representative.

title: Kniprodestraße, Berlin
description:
Wir vermieten unsere möblierte 3-Zimmer-Wohnung in Prenzlauer Berg auf Zeit. Die Wohnung wird bisher von uns selbst genutzt und während unseres beruflich bedingten Aufenthalts außerhalb von Berlin befristet vermietet.  

Die rund 57 m2 große Wohnung befindet sich im Hochparterre eines gepflegten Mehrfamilienhauses und verfügt über einen großen Balkon. Die Wohnung wird zunächst für sechs bis zwölf Monate vermietet. Eine Verlängerung ist ggf. möglich.  

Ausstattung

Die Wohnung ist vollständig eingerichtet und sofort bezugsfertig. Sie eignet sich ideal für Berufstätige, Expats oder Paare.  Zur Ausstattung gehören unter anderem:  
* Großer Balkon 
* Voll ausgestattete Einbauküche mit Spülmaschine, Waschmaschine, Backofen, Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach und Induktionsherd 
* Geschirr, Besteck und Küchenutensilien nach Bedarf und Absprache 
* Schlafzimmer mit Boxspringbett (1,80 x 2 m) 
* Kleiderschrank und mehrere Kommoden 
* Separates Arbeits- oder Gästezimmer 
* Helles Wohnzimmer mit Sofa, Fernseher und Essbereich (Esstisch mit Stühlen noch nicht auf den Fotos) 
* Kleines Badezimmer mit Badewanne und integrierter Dusche 
* DSL 100 
* Fahrradkeller 
* Pkw-Stellplatz auf dem Grundstück  

Perfekte Lage  

Die Wohnung liegt hervorragend angebunden im Berliner Stadtteil Prenzlauer Berg.  

* Bushaltestelle der Linie 200 direkt vor der Haustür 
* In rund 10 Minuten mit Bus oder Fahrrad am Alexanderplatz 
* Die S- und Straßenbahn-Haltestellen Greifswalder Straße und Landsberger Allee sind jeweils etwa 12 Gehminuten entfernt 
* Lidl (mit Lademöglichkeit für E-Autos) schräg gegenüber 
* Kaufland, Netto und EDEKA bequem fußläufig erreichbar 
* Der Volkspark Friedrichshain und der Bötzowkiez sind in etwa 10 Minuten zu Fuß erreichbar  

Mietkonditionen  

* Pauschalmiete: 1.499 € pro Monat (inklusive aller Nebenkosten) 
* Verfügbar ab: 15. September 2026 
* Mietdauer: zunächst 6 Monate, Verlängerung nach Absprache ggf. möglich  

Das wünschen wir uns

Wir suchen zuverlässige Mieterinnen oder Mieter, die die Wohnung pfleglich behandeln.  
* Nur Nichtraucher 
* Keine Haustiere  

Bitte sende uns bei Interesse eine kurze Vorstellung mit Angaben zu deiner Person, Beruf, dem gewünschten Mietzeitraum und dem Grund deines Aufenthalts in Berlin. Eine zeitnahe Besichtigung ist vor Ort oder digital möglich. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu lesen!

title: Türkenstraße, Berlin
description:
This bright and inviting apartment features a charming private terrace and is located in a peaceful residential building. Tastefully furnished with the new furniture in warm, elegant beige tones, it offers a cozy and welcoming atmosphere that instantly feels like home.
It’s an ideal choice for young professionals, newcomers to Berlin, or anyone looking for a comfortable and stylish place to settle in. The apartment combines plenty of living space with everything you need for a convenient stay and online working.
The fully equipped kitchen includes a fridge with freezer, oven, stovetop, kettle and coffee machine, as well as essential kitchenware, utensils, cutlery and a dishwasher. Additional items can be provided upon request, making it easy to feel at home from day one.
Bus und U-Bahn stations U6 are 5 min walking distance.
Located in the vibrant and popular Berlin-Wedding neighborhood and very close to the city centre this charming apartment is tucked away in a peaceful residential area close to the beautiful Schillerpark. Just a short walk away, you’ll find a great selection of bakeries, cafés, bars, restaurants, local and big grocery shops, yoga and fitness studios, and plenty of options for leisure and entertainment.
Beautiful Plötzensee lake with sandy beach is just a short bike trip away.

title: Finowstraße, Berlin
description:
Wenn du eine Wohnung suchst, die Ruhe, Design und urbanes Leben miteinander verbindet, bist du hier genau richtig. Die Wohnung ist im modernen Japandi-Stil eingerichtet – einer harmonischen Mischung aus skandinavischer Gemütlichkeit und japanischer Klarheit. Natürliche Materialien, warme Farbtöne und eine bewusst reduzierte Einrichtung schaffen eine entspannte Atmosphäre, in der du dich vom ersten Tag an wohlfühlen kannst.

Ein besonderes Highlight ist der nach Westen ausgerichtete Balkon. Hier kannst du die Nachmittags- und Abendsonne genießen, bei einem Kaffee in den Tag starten oder den Berliner Sonnenuntergang entspannt ausklingen lassen.

Die Wohnung ist komplett ausgestattet und bietet alles, was du für einen angenehmen Aufenthalt brauchst – egal, ob du für einige Monate in Berlin arbeitest, die Stadt erkundest oder einfach ein schönes Zuhause auf Zeit suchst.

title: Andreasstraße, Berlin
description:
ANTONIUS is a refined, fully furnished residence offering approximately 131 qm of contemporary living in Berlin-Friedrichshain. Two private bedrooms, two full bathrooms and a generous open-plan living and dining area create an exceptional sense of space. A private balcony, a fully equipped kitchen with AEG appliances, dedicated workspaces and high-speed Wi-Fi make the apartment ideally suited to executive assignments, relocations and sophisticated mid-term living. Lift access, step-free entry and a private underground parking space complete the offering. Available for stays of 6 to 24 months and suitable for up to three residents. The monthly rent includes furniture, kitchen equipment, operating and heating costs, electricity, high-speed internet and one underground parking space.

A separate utility room provides a washing machine, drying racks and practical shelving. Registration is possible, and a detailed inventory will be provided at handover.

title: Kleine Alexanderstraße, Berlin
description:
**Rental Period**
3–12 months. Registration (Anmeldung) is possible.

## Property Description

This modern and very well-maintained apartment is located in a high-quality new-build development on a quiet side street just a few minutes from Alexanderplatz.

The building offers a 24-hour doorman service, providing residents with additional convenience and security.

The residential complex also features a beautifully landscaped inner courtyard with a playground and seating areas.

## Facilities

The elevator takes you directly to the apartment door.

The apartment includes a modern bathroom with a shower and a washer-dryer.

Underfloor heating is installed throughout the entire apartment.

The apartment also has a balcony with a beautiful view of the Berlin TV Tower.

The bedroom is furnished with a large double bed, a spacious wardrobe and an additional storage cupboard containing a Dyson vacuum cleaner, ironing board and clothes drying rack.

The living room is equipped with a comfortable sofa bed, providing additional sleeping space when needed.

The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need, including a dishwasher, coffee machine, pots, pans, dishes, glasses and cutlery – all you need to bring is the food.

The living room features a large TV with cable connection as well as AirPlay and Google Cast. High-speed Wi-Fi is, of course, available throughout the apartment.

An underground parking space is available for an additional **€130 per month**. The parking space is also suitable for larger SUVs and is located very close to the elevator.

Despite its extremely central location, the apartment is exceptionally quiet due to its position within the residential complex. At the same time, the generous distance to the surrounding buildings provides a high level of privacy.

**No pets allowed.**

## Location

Alexanderplatz and Alexanderplatz train station can be reached within approximately **5 minutes on foot**.

A huge selection of restaurants, cafés, bars, supermarkets, shops and other amenities is also available within just a few minutes' walk.

Thanks to its central location, the apartment offers excellent public transport connections and is an ideal base for enjoying everything Berlin has to offer.

title: Retzbacher Weg, Berlin
description:
Very bright and silent apartment. With 2 bright furnished rooms plus kitchen plus bathroom. The kitchen is fully equipped with a dishwasher, washing machine etc. The bathroom is with a bath tub. Prices for heater, water and everything else is included. There are also towels, sheets and all you need to directly start living.

In the garden belonging to the house you can use the garden benches to chill. The garden is very silent and as hugh like a park.

The apartment is located in a green, silent and very safe part of Berlin "Pankow". 15 Minutes to walk is the great Florakiez with bars, cafés, shops etc. and where the young life plays. 3 minutes to walk to Bus X54 which goes directly to S, U and Tram Pankow. Or 12 minutes to walk to S,U and Tram Pankow directely. Its also in the area where you can use e-scooters (like Bolt, Tier, Lime, Voi). With it you just need 3 minutes to S/U Pankow. 

I offer the flat just for a period of time and just for people who stay temporarily in Berlin for one or two years (like for a project, PhD, limited working contract, exchange year etc) and are looking for a cosy fully furnished apartment. 

Anmeldung / registration is possible of course.

Every room can be equipped with a queen-size bed and a desk. If you just need one bed just tell me.

title: Käthe-Niederkirchner-Straße, Berlin
description: This beautifully renovated 1-bedroom apartment with an open-plan living and dining area sits on the second floor of a Jugendstil building from 1902 in Berlin's sought-after Bötzowviertel. Wide-plank oak floors, high ceilings and bright walls give it real old-Berlin character, and it's furnished in a modern yet cosy style. The living and dining area seats up to six at the table, with a separate bedroom and a small balcony overlooking a quiet inner courtyard. The bathroom has a rain shower and a bathtub, and the kitchen comes fully equipped. The apartment also comes with a cellar room for extra storage. Käthe-Niederkirchner-Straße is a quiet street just around the corner from the cafes, restaurants and design shops of Hufelandstraße, with Greifswalder Straße three minutes on foot for everyday shopping and Volkspark Friedrichshain right on your doorstep. Trams, the S-Bahn and bus stops are all close by, putting Alexanderplatz and the city centre about 2 km away.

title: An der Mole, Berlin
description:
Note : Please only book for 2 months initially but with the intention of staying for 6 months or longer. We can discuss the details and plan the contract extension.

We are renting out our beautifully and fully furnished 3 zimmer apartment for an initial period of one year, with the option to extend. The apartment is fully equipped and ready for immediate occupancy, you can practically move right in.

The apartment features two spacious bedrooms, a large hallway, a cozy hall with dinign area, a fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom, a storage room, and a balcony. A basement storage unit is also included, and secure, lockable bicycle storage is available in the basement. If needed, a parking space in the adjacent building can be rented for an additional fee.

The apartment is tastefully furnished with high-quality pieces, and all bedrooms offer a beautiful view of the river and the garden. Water and garden view from all the bedrooms, direct ringbahn, city line, bus, tram and regional train access within 300m walk.

title: Raumerstraße, Berlin
description:
Bright top-floor room available in a beautiful apartment in Prenzlauer Berg, with lots of natural light and a private rooftop terrace.

The apartment is very well connected, with the M10 tram nearby, while still feeling calm and residential and off the main street. There are many cafes, restaurants and parks within a five minutes walking distance as well. One of the nicest features is the private elevator, shared with only one other neighbor in the building and can only be accessed with a key.

You would share the apartment with one female professional roommate. She is independent and respectful, so this would be a good fit for someone who values having their own space and a peaceful home environment rather than a highly social WG.

The rooftop terrace is for the exclusive use of the apartment and is a great place to sit outside, work, read, or enjoy the view. Being on the top floor also means the apartment gets excellent natural light throughout the day. The apartment has a dishwasher, washer, fully equipped kitchen, tv, shower, bathtub, 1.5 baths, Wifi, and cellar storage.

Ideal for a professional, freelancer, or someone temporarily based in Berlin who is looking for a comfortable, quiet, well-connected home in Prenzlauer Berg.

title: Mollstraße, Berlin
description:

title: Danziger Straße, Berlin
description:

title: Thulestraße, Berlin
description:
Aufgrund eines längeren Auslandsaufenthalts vermiete ich meine helle und ruhige Dachgeschosswohnung in attraktiver Lage in Pankow / Prenzlauer Berg.
Die Wohnung besticht durch ihre lichtdurchfluteten Räume, eine angenehme Wohnatmosphäre und eine ruhige Umgebung. Gleichzeitig profitieren Sie von einer hervorragenden Infrastruktur mit zahlreichen Cafés, Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sowie einer guten Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.
Die Wohnung eignet sich ideal für Singles oder Paare, die für einen längeren Zeitraum ein komfortables Zuhause in einem der beliebtesten Berliner Stadtteile suchen.
Ein PKW - Stellplatz kann auf Wunsch zusätzlich angemietet werden.

Due to an extended stay abroad, I am offering my bright and quiet top-floor apartment for rent in the sought-after area of Pankow / Prenzlauer Berg.
The apartment features plenty of natural light, a peaceful atmosphere, and a comfortable living environment. At the same time, it offers excellent access to cafés, restaurants, shops, and public transportation.
It is an ideal home for singles or couples looking for a comfortable place to stay in one of Berlin's most desirable neighborhoods.
A parking space is available and can be rented separately upon request.

title: Florastraße, Berlin
description:
Die 2-Zimmer Wohnung ist großzügig geschnitten und bietet den idealen Rückzugsort für ein Paar oder eine alleinstehende Person. NICHT FÜR FAMILIEN MIT KLEINKIND ODER WGs GEDACHT!

NOT SUITABLE FOR FAMILIES WITH KIDS OR FLATSHARING!

*Der Flur*
Man betritt die Wohnung durch einen freundlich und hell gestalteten Flur, welcher Platz zum Eintreten gibt und vom Flur abgehend gibt es einen Abstellraum, der viel Stauraum bietet.

*Das Schlafzimmer*
Das Schlafzimmer (ausgestattet mit einem geräumigen Queensizebett und einem großen Kleiderschrank) sowie einer Sitzgelegenheit und Kommode bietet genügend Platz um sich wohl zu fühlen.

*Das Wohnzimmer*
Im Wohnzimmer ist neben einer Sitzecke mit Sofa (welches für Besuch auch eine weitere Schlafgelegenheit bietet) und Flachbildschirm TV auch eine Büroecke vorhanden. Vom Wohnzimmer abgehend befindet sich der Balkon, von dem man einen schönen Blick auf den berühmten Florakiez hat.

*Die Küche*
Ins Wohnzimmer integriert verfügt die offene Küche über eine weitere Sitzgelegenheit zum Essen. Die Einbauküche ist mit allen notwenigen Geräten (Kühlschrank, Gefrierschrank, Gasherd und Backofen, Spülmaschine, Wasserkocher, Kaffeemaschine) und mit ausreichend Geschirr und Töpfen ausgestattet.

*Das Bad*
Hervorzuheben am Badezimmer ist die Ausstattung mit einer Badewanne. Zudem steht eine Waschmaschine für den persönlichen Gebrauch im Badezimmer zur Verfügung.

*Das Gebäude*
Das Gebäude wird von einem Hausmeisterservice gepflegt, der sich um die Hof- und Treppenhausreinigung kümmert.

PERFEKTE LAGE GARANTIERT EINEN HOHEN FREIZEITWERT:
Das Haus liegt im Berliner Norden, im familienfreundlichen und jungen Ortsteil Pankow des gleichnamigen Bezirks. Die Straße zeichnet sich durch einen ausgewogenen Mix aus Alt- und Neubauten aus. Alte und junge Bäume säumen den Straßenrand.
- In der Nähe befinden sich verschiedene Einkaufsmöglichkeiten für Dinge des
täglichen Bedarfs wie Supermärkte, Apotheken, Drougerien, aber auch Kiezshops
und einige Cafes sowie zwei ÄrzteZentren.
- Rund um den S-Bahnhof Pankow bis zum Rathaus Pankow erstreckt sich das
Stadtteilzentrum mit zahlreichen Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Bars, Cafes und
Restaurants verschiedener internationaler Küchen. Im Kern dieses Zentrums liegt
der ehemalige Dorfanger des im 13. Jhd. entstandenen Dorfes Pankow.
- Fernab des Metropolen-Trubels lassen sich im Bürgerpark oder im Schlosspark
entspannte Stunden verbringen. Bei einem Spaziergang lassen sich noch andere Kleinode entdecken, bspw. Kleine Galerien, der Kinderbauernhof an der Panke oder das in der ersten Hälfte des 18. Jgd. Erbaute Schloss Schönhausen mit seiner
beeindruckend bewegten Geschichte.

ÖFFENTLICHE VERKEHRSMITTEL:
Die Anbindung an den öffentlichen Verkehr ist ideal. Es gibt gleich drei BVG-
Verkehrsmittel, die innerhalb von 3 Minuten Fußweg erreicht werden können:
- U-Bahn, S-Bahn und die beiden Tramlinien M1 und M13.
AUTOANBINDUNG:
- Mit dem PKW ist die City-Ost via Berliner Straße und Schönhauser Allee (B96a) schnell zu erreichen. Das Berliner Umland ist über die Stadtautobahn A114
(Anschlussstelle Pasewalker Straße) schnell erreicht.


Eine Endabrechnung der Nebenkosten wird am Ende der Mietzeit erstellt und ein Verbrauch von Strom, Gas und Heizung, der über die übliche Verbrauchshöhe hinaus geht, wird in Rechnung gestellt..

title: Preunelstraße, Berlin
description:
Located on Preunelstraße in the northern district of Pankow, this fully furnished apartment offers a quiet, residential living environment. The property provides a peaceful retreat while maintaining a direct connection to the rest of the city via Berlin's public transit network.

title: Zionskirchstraße, Berlin
description:
Diese helle, geschmackvoll möblierte Altbauwohnung mit 82 m2 liegt direkt am idyllischen Zionskirchplatz im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte. Sie befindet sich im dritten Obergeschoss eines schönen Altbaus und verbindet eine hochwertige Ausstattung mit einem besonderen Blick ins Grüne und auf die historische Zionskirche.

Die Wohnung verfügt über ein großzügiges Wohnzimmer, ein Schlafzimmer mit Doppelbett, ein Arbeits- und Gästezimmer mit Schlafsofa sowie eine separate, vollständig ausgestattete Wohnküche mit Essplatz. Parkett in den Wohn- und Schlafräumen sorgt für eine warme Atmosphäre. Das Badezimmer ist mit einer Badewanne mit Duschmöglichkeit ausgestattet.

Zwei Zimmer liegen zum Zionskirchplatz und bieten einen schönen Blick über den Platz auf die Zionskirche. Eines davon verfügt über einen französischen Balkon. Zusätzlich gibt es einen separaten, begehbaren Balkon mit Sitzgelegenheiten zum ruhigen Innenhof – ein angenehmer Rückzugsort für den Morgenkaffee oder entspannte Abende.

Die Wohnung wurde renoviert und ist für einen komfortablen längeren Aufenthalt vollständig eingerichtet. Die hochwertige neue Einbauküche verfügt über ein BORA-Induktionskochfeld und einen Geschirrspüler. Zur weiteren Ausstattung gehören eine Waschmaschine, ein Trockner, schnelles Internet mit 250 Mbit/s sowie Bettwäsche und Handtücher.

Trotz der zentralen Lage bietet die Wohnung eine angenehm ruhige und entspannte Wohnatmosphäre – in einer der schönsten und begehrtesten Wohnlagen von Berlin-Mitte.

description:
**Möblierte 3-Zimmer-Wohnung, 95 m2, Friedrichshain, 01.11.2026 bis 15.01.2027**

wir vermieten unsere schöne, möblierte Wohnung in Friedrichshain für zweieinhalb Monate unter und suchen jemanden, der sich hier genauso wohlfühlt wie wir.

• Bad mit Badewanne, Waschmaschine & Trockner
• Balkon zum ruhigen Innenhof

Unsere persönlichen Sachen bleiben in einigen geschlossenen Schränken. Ein Schrankabschnitt im Schlafzimmer steht dir natürlich zur Verfügung.

**💰 Konditionen**

• **1.350 € / Monat all-inclusive**
• **Gesamt für den gesamten Zeitraum: 3.375 €**
• Kaution: 1.350 €
• Zeitraum: **01.11.2026 bis 15.01.2027**
• Anmeldung möglich
• Für Singles, Paare oder eine Familie mit Kind
• Nichtraucher
• Keine Haustiere
• Private Haftpflichtversicherung erforderlich
• Untervermietung mit Zustimmung unseres Vermieters

**👋 Wer wir sind / Wen wir suchen**

Wir wünschen uns jemanden, der gut mit der Wohnung umgeht und sie für die Zeit wie sein eigenes Zuhause behandelt.

Wenn du Interesse hast, schreib uns bitte kurz, wer du bist, wer mit dir einziehen würde und was dich für die Zeit nach Berlin führt. Schick uns bitte auch einen Einkommens- oder Arbeitsnachweis.

Wir melden uns bei vollständigen Nachrichten und vereinbaren anschließend einen kurzen Videocall zum Kennenlernen. Für den Vertrag und die Genehmigung des Vermieters benötigen wir von der ausgewählten Person anschließend noch Geburtsdatum und aktuelle Meldeanschrift.

Deutsch, Englisch und Spanisch sind alle willkommen. 😊

**[ENGLISH]**

**Furnished 3-room flat, 95 m2, Friedrichshain, 01.11.2026 to 15.01.2027**

Hello! 😊

We're subletting our lovely furnished flat in Friedrichshain for two and a half months and are looking for someone who will feel at home here.

The flat is ideal if you're spending a few months in Berlin and would prefer a proper apartment rather than a room in a shared flat.

**🏡 The flat**

• 95 m2
• 5th floor with lift
• Between Ostkreuz and Frankfurter Allee
• S-Bahn, U5 and supermarkets within walking distance
• Large living room with dining area
• Large, fully equipped kitchen
• Bedroom with double bed
• Office room, which can also be used as a second bedroom (inflatable mattress available)
• Bathroom with bathtub, washing machine & dryer
• Balcony overlooking the quiet courtyard

Our personal belongings will remain in some of the closed cupboards. One section of the bedroom wardrobe will be completely free for you.

**💰 Conditions**

• **€1,350/month, all-inclusive**
• **€3,375 total for the entire period**
• Deposit: €1,350
• Period: **01.11.2026 to 15.01.2027**
• Anmeldung possible
• Suitable for singles, couples or a family with a child
• Non-smoking
• No pets

• Subletting with our landlord's approval

**👋 Who we're looking for**

We're looking for someone who will treat the flat with care and enjoy making it their home for the time they're here.

If you're interested, please tell us a little about yourself, who would be living in the flat and what brings you to Berlin during this period. Please also include proof of income or employment.

We'll get back to complete enquiries and then arrange a short video call to get to know each other. For the contract and landlord approval, we'll subsequently need the selected person's date of birth and current registered address.

English, German and Spanish are all welcome. 😊

title: Seumestraße, Berlin
description:
Facing south and therefore very bright, this 68 sqm apartment surprises you with a warm impression that is noticeably enhanced by a solid wood floor and many solid wood furniture pieces.

The apartment includes a fully equipped built-in kitchen with a microwave and dishwasher. There is also a washing machine and a new separate laundry dryer from Siemens, both ready for use.

In Room 1, you'll find a 55-inch Samsung Smart TV placed on a solid mango wood lowboard. The dining table and chest of drawers are also made of solid mango wood. Additionally, there is a high-quality sofa bed measuring 140 x 200 cm, which is suitable for longer-term use.

In Room 2, there is a 50-inch Samsung Smart TV. A solid oak desk makes working from home easier with its warm appearance.
The bed is 160x200 cm.

All lamps in the kitchen, bedroom, and living room are dimmable and feature 3-4 different color settings.

On the approximately 4 square meter sunny east-south-west balcony, you can enjoy the sun until the evening hours.

The nearest supermarkets are located in close proximity. Numerous restaurants and entertainment options of all kinds of cultural variety are just "around the corner."

Additional Information:
This is the Price for 2 Peopel. For each person  more it is 150 Euro extra.

title: Wadzeckstraße, Berlin
description:
Zur Vermietung steht ein ca. 10 m2 großes Zimmer in einer 3-Zimmer-Wohnung in Berlin-Mitte, in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Alexanderplatz.

Ausstattung der Wohnung:

Lage: Die Wohnung liegt zentral in Berlin-Mitte, nahe dem Alexanderplatz. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sowie Bus-, Tram-, U-Bahn- und S-Bahn-Haltestellen befinden sich in fußläufiger Entfernung.

Bei Interesse freue ich mich über eine Nachricht.

title: Finowstraße, Berlin
description:
This charming 2-room period apartment is located on the 4th floor of an extensively renovated building from 1912, in the quiet side wing. With a living area of approx. 60 m2, its well-thought-out floor plan, open Nobilia kitchen-living area and lovingly selected furniture offer a stylish temporary home. The approx. 3.40 m high ceilings, original wooden floorboards and large double-casement windows give the apartment its typical Berlin period charm.

The apartment is furnished with high-quality designer pieces (e.g. Vitra, HAY, Eiermann, String, Artemide, Pedestal) and is ready to move into immediately – including washer-dryer, Smart TV (4K), bed linen, towels, crockery, vacuum cleaner and much more. A cellar room of approx. 5 m2 and bicycle parking in the courtyard are also included.

Features (excerpt):
- Furnished incl. double bed & sofa bed
- Modern fitted kitchen (Nobilia) with dishwasher
- Bathroom with natural light and bathtub
- Washer-dryer (Bauknecht)
- Smart TV, WiFi-enabled
- Alexa Echo Dot Max
- Sonos Era 100
- Apple TV & Fire TV
- Smart home features (e.g. WiFi lights, tado WiFi thermostats, Bold electronic lock)
- Home office equipment (e.g. monitor, keyboard, mouse, webcam)
- Period building with stucco elements & wooden floorboards
- Quiet location in the side wing
- Cellar compartment and bicycle parking

The apartment is located on Finowstraße – in the heart of the popular Boxhagener Kiez in Berlin-Friedrichshain. Numerous cafés, restaurants, boutiques and weekly markets are right around the corner. The Spree river and Volkspark Friedrichshain offer green spaces for relaxation.

Just a few minutes' walk away is the Berlin Ostkreuz transport hub, with direct connections to the S-Bahn, regional trains and tram – ideal for commuters and city explorers.

title: Retzbacher Weg, Berlin
description:
Furnished 2-room apartment with balcony in Pankow for sublet | €1,200 negotiable | December 16 - December 28 | Option to take over the lease

Bright and fully furnished 2-room apartment with approximately 49 m2 of living space in a quiet, green location in Berlin-Pankow, available for sublet from December 16 - December 28, 2026 (flexible), with an option to take over the lease afterward. 

Please note that €1200 is the sublet rent, which is possible till Dec 28, 2026. Starting January, if you want to take over the lease, the rent is 1440 EUR per month for one person.

The apartment features a balcony overlooking greenery, a fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher, refrigerator, oven, and microwave, a washing machine, and fast Wi-Fi. It is ideal for a single person or a couple.

The flat-rate sublet rent is €1,200 per month (calculated on a daily basis), including utilities, electricity, heating, water, and internet. The price is negotiable.

Excellent Location and Connections:

The apartment is located in the quiet and leafy Kissingen district of Pankow, with excellent connections to Prenzlauer Berg, Mitte, and Berlin's city center.

- Prenzlauer Berg: Just a few subway stops away, with numerous cafes, restaurants, and shops.

- Alexanderplatz & Mitte: Reachable in about 20 minutes.

- Pankow S-Bahn and U-Bahn: A few minutes by bus or about a 10-minute walk.

- Retzbacher Weg Bus Stop: Directly in front of the building.

- Shopping: EDEKA, Lidl, Kaufland, and other shops nearby.

The neighborhood is quiet, green, and family-friendly. The apartment offers an ideal combination of a relaxed living atmosphere and quick access to the city center.

Option to Take Over the Lease:

If interested, there is the option to take over the apartment on a longer-term basis after the sublease. The lease takeover, long term rent and the final terms are subject to the landlord's approval.

Registration: Not possible during short-term subletting. Registration is possible for longer-term lease takeovers.

The subletting period is flexible and can be adjusted by arrangement. Subletting is subject to the landlord's approval.

If you are interested, please contact me and I would be happy to arrange a viewing appointment!

title: Michaelkirchstraße, Berlin
description:
English version below

Liebe Interessierte,

wir suchen Zwischenmieter:innen für unsere gemütliche, helle Wohnung in Engelbecken-Nähe: 3 Zimmer, 60 m2, Neubau mit Balkon, komplett möbliert und kinderfreundlich.
Zeitraum: 31. Dezember 2026 bis 26. März 2027.

Dear all,

we're looking to sublet our cozy, bright apartment for three months, from the 31st of December 2026 till the 26th of March 2027. The 60m2 flat is situated near Engelbecken and has two bedrooms, a Wohnküche and a nice balcony. The flat is fully furnished and child-friendly.
Rent is 1050€ per month, all costs included (in total for the time 3150 €)
A registration may be possible.

title: Kernhofer Straße, Berlin
description:
A bright and spacious home in a quiet, green setting – just 10 minutes from Ostkreuz

A quiet residential setting with fast connections into central Berlin: this fully furnished three-room apartment (105 m2, built 2016) sits on a green, calm street – yet Ostkreuz station, cafés, restaurants and shops are only about a 10-minute walk away, and the Rummelsburger Bucht waterfront is just around the corner.

The heart of the home is the open-plan kitchen with its large cooking island, flowing into a bright, comfortable living and dining area with big windows overlooking the treetops. The generous south-facing balcony gets sun throughout the day – perfect for breakfast, working outside or simply relaxing.

There is a proper home office in the second bedroom, with an electrically height-adjustable desk, fast internet (up to 400 Mbit/s) and everything you need to work comfortably during a longer stay.

The apartment is ideal for families and pet owners: pets are warmly welcome, the main bedroom has a king-size bed, and the second bedroom is set up as a children's room with a kids' bed and a pull-out trundle bed (2 sleeping spaces, 90 × 200 cm each). The living room additionally offers a comfortable sofa bed – ideal for a family of four or for visiting guests. Two separate bathrooms – a main bathroom with bathtub and separate shower plus a guest bathroom – keep everyday life relaxed even when the apartment is fully occupied.

Highlights
• Quiet, green location – about 10 minutes on foot from Ostkreuz
• Pet-friendly and family-friendly
• Large open kitchen with cooking island
• Spacious south-facing balcony
• Separate home office with electrically height-adjustable desk
• Fast internet, up to 400 Mbit/s
• King-size bed in the main bedroom
• Kids' bed with pull-out trundle bed (2 sleeping spaces)
• Comfortable sofa bed for guests
• 65-inch 4K OLED TV with Apple TV
• Walk-in wardrobe
• Main bathroom with bathtub and separate shower + additional guest bathroom
• Washing machine and dryer, dishwasher
• Fully furnished · lift · door intercom

All-inclusive rent: heating, electricity, water, internet and furniture are included. Registration (Anmeldung) is possible – a Wohnungsgeberbestätigung is provided.

Additional information
• Weekly cleaning upon request for €60
• One-time final cleaning fee €250
• No smoking in the apartment – only on the balcony
• No loud noise after 10 pm
• Energy certificate: demand-based, 74.9 kWh/(m2·a), class B, combined heat and power (CHP), built 2016

title: Paul-Zobel-Straße, Berlin
description:
Property: 80 m2 and on the top (4th) floor. It has 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a large living room / kitchen room with a balcony. 1 bedroom (Zimmer 2 in floorplan) is reserved for owner use (see below).  

Rent: 1,000 EUR per month warm.  Deposit 1,500 EUR.

Anmeldung possible.  No subletting permitted. Pets possible by discussion.

Duration: Now until end April 2027. Possibility of extension 1-2 months depending on owner’s personal situation - can be discussed nearer end of contract.

Apartment is fully furnished with modern high-quality furniture and equipment.  This includes a high quality ceiling mounted projector and surround sound system in the living room.  Heating can be set on a timer and controlled remotely by app.  There is a large washing machine, dishwasher, fridge, freezer, and high quality electric hobs and oven.  The main shower is high quality and also has a bath. A full range of cooking and cleaning equipment will be available, also a monitor and stationery for working. There is a locked communal basement area for bike storage, and a dedicated underground parking space.

The owner, (me, Oliver) would occasionally want stay in the guest room in the apartment, but no more than 1 week per month and probably less (especially in 2026). We would both meet virtually before concluding the contract to ensure we are both happy with the arrangement.  If this is a major issue for you, this can be discussed. 

I am a 35 year old man from the UK who has lived in Berlin for 4 years.  During the rental period I will mostly be in the UK to support with an unexpected family medical situation. You would be given notice of visits - there would be no surprise appearances.  I am friendly, easy to get along with, and respectful of the needs of tenants given my own experiences of being a renter in Berlin.  I am looking for someone who will treat the apartment respectfully and be easy to get along with when I am in Berlin.  

A professional clean would be undertaken at the start of your move-in, at my expense, with expectation that the apartment would be left in a similar standard at the end of the tenancy.

Location: Off Möllendorfstr. 10367.  2 minutes walk from tram stop Möllensdorfstr- / Storkower Str. (16, 21, M10, M13). 5 minutes walk from tram stop Bernhard-Bästlein-Str. (18, 21, M4, M5, M8, M10, M13).  20 minutes walk (or 5 min bus / tram ride) from S-Frankfurter Allee (U5, Ring-Bahn), S-Storkower Str (Ring-Bahn).

The area and the building are residential family locations.  The neighbours are friendly and a mix of young families and older people.

PROPERTY
Our two newly built buildings surrounded by a green courtyard create a safe secluded space for you to find peace in the midst of Berlins city life. title: Choriner Straße, Berlin
description: Discover a uniquely designed apartment in the trendy district of Berlin-Mitte. Located in the rear building overlooking a garden, the apartment offers exceptional tranquility despite its central location. Surrounded by renowned restaurants, trendy bars, and elegant boutiques, the apartment combines modern design with high-end finishes. The bathroom features underfloor heating, a spacious walk-in rain shower, and integrated speakers for an extra touch of comfort. title: Lehderstraße, Berlin
description:
Spacious 100 m2 furnished apartment in Weißensee, next to Prenzlauer Berg | Dec 1 – Feb 1 (flexible)

Sublet my fully furnished 100 m2 ground-floor apartment for the winter. 
Available: Dec 1 – Feb 1. 
Rent: €1,400 per month, heating included. [Electricity/internet: included]

The apartment

Living room: Sofa, Smart TV, Hue lamps, easy chair
Bedroom: 200x200 bed, large wardrobe, coffee table, chair
Study/guest room: large desk, monitor, spare bed, perfect for working from home
Kitchen: fully equipped with large fridge, dishwasher, oven, microwave, air fryer and food processor
Washing machine, 1 Gbps Wi-Fi, heating included
Ground floor

Location
REWE, Aldi, dm and Netto are all within 2-5 minutes on foot. The nearest tram stop (Ostseestraße or Gustav-Adolf-Straße) is about 5 minutes away, and S-Bahn Prenzlauer Allee is just two tram stops from there. That makes it easy to reach Prenzlauer Berg and the rest of the city.

Nearby you’ll find:

Weißer See and its park, great for winter walks, with the lakeside Milchhäuschen café-restaurant
Kino Toni, a charming arthouse cinema at Antonplatz, open for over 100 years
Caligariplatz, a small square with a nod to Weißensee’s silent-film history
Prenzlauer Berg’s cafés, restaurants and shops, a short tram ride away


Please note

No smoking and no parties
Anmeldung (city registration) is not possible
A few of my personal belongings will remain in the apartment

I’m looking for a respectful, reliable tenant. Please send me a short introduction, your planned dates and the number of people. I’m happy to arrange a video call or a viewing.

title: Wichertstraße, Berlin
description:
Furnished 1-bedroom flat with balcony in Prenzlauer Berg

Furnished flat of approximately 72 m2 on Wichertstraße, 10439 Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. Located on the fourth floor of the front building, it has a living room with a dining table, a separate bedroom, a separate kitchen, a bathroom and a storage room.

FURNITURE AND EQUIPMENT

• High ceilings, decorative plasterwork and wooden floorboards
• Living room with a sofa, television, shelving and a dining table with chairs and a bench
• Bedroom with a double bed, large wardrobe and chest of drawers
• Space for a workspace in the bedroom
• Nolte fitted kitchen with a Bosch oven, ceramic hob, microwave, dishwasher and extractor hood
• Side-by-side fridge-freezer
• Samsung washer-dryer
• Bathroom with a window, bathtub and shower
• Approximately 4 m2 balcony with seating
• Double-glazed windows

LOCATION

Close to Prenzlauer Allee S-Bahn station, with connections to the Ringbahn and the M2 tram towards Alexanderplatz.

RENT AND AVAILABILITY

Monthly rent: €1,950
Household electricity, internet and the broadcasting contribution are additional and paid separately by the tenant.

Rental period: initially up to 12 months, with the possibility of an extension afterwards by agreement.

Expected availability from December 2026; availability and the exact move-in date are still to be confirmed.

ENERGY INFORMATION

Demand-based energy certificate; final energy demand: 145.0 kWh/(m2·year); energy efficiency class E; building year according to the certificate: 1908; principal energy sources: natural gas and electricity mix. Valid until 22 October 2029.

If interested, please send a short introduction, the number of people moving in, your preferred move-in date and the rental period you are looking for. Viewings by arrangement. Enquiries in English or German are welcome.
